articleTitle: Remote monitoring of heart rate and ECG signal using ESP32
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Heart conditions of human body can be detected by the electrical signal from heart which is called electrocardiogram (ECG) and heart rate which is the number of heart beat per minute (BPM). ECG is the result of electric signal of heart that is caused of the heart to beat. The result is shown as a wave on a monitor or graph paper. Heart disease has become a very big issue nowadays. Many people get sick or even die because of the inability to monitor their heart conditions properly. This serious issue can be prevented by monitoring the heart’s condition regularly. It would be great if this monitoring can be done remotely. In this paper, such a system is proposed by using AD8232 single lead heart beat sensor to extract the ECG signal and pulse sensor to get the BPM. The obtained sensor data are transmitted to the cloud server internet using ESP32 microcontroller which has Wi-Fi capability for remote monitoring by a health specialist. Ubidots and Thingspeak platforms are used as a cloud server. As a result, any health specialist can check the patient’s heart condition at anytime from anywhere and can take necessary steps.

articleTitle: Obstacle Avoidance Path Planning Based on Improved APF and RRT
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: In recent years, collaborative robots have been widely used in the field of intelligent manufacturing. Obstacle avoidance path planning, as a key technology of collaborative robots in motion planning, is becoming more and more important. In order to solve the shortcomings of APF easily falling into local minimums and the shortcomings of RRT's strong randomness, this paper improves and combines these two algorithms. Firstly, artificial potential field algorithm is used in local obstacle avoidance path planning. When falling into local minimum, the improved RRT algorithm can adaptively select the temporary target point and make the search process jump out of the local minimum point. In addition, artificial potential field algorithm will be applied when the robot arm leaves the local minimum. Finally, we use a greedy algorithm to remove redundant nodes in the path. Experiments show that this algorithm can greatly improve the success rate of planning and reduce planning time.

articleTitle: An Improved Path Planning Algorithm for UAV Based on RRT
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: For RRT and RRT * algorithm, the search time is long, low sampling efficiency and planning path twists and turns, someone put forward a kind of narrow two-way rapid extension of optimal sampling space random tree algorithm. In each iteration of the algorithm, two random trees are extended, and two new nodes can be generated in one iteration to accelerate the expansion speed. Then an ellipse interval sampling is constructed with the starting point and the target point as the focus, and the length of the trajectory as the long axis. The idea of continuously reducing the sampling space in the iteration makes the two random trees expand towards their respective target points under a certain probability. In the simulation experiment, the proposed algorithm is compared with RRT*, and the results show that the improved algorithm improves the convergence speed and reduces the track distance under the premise of optimizing the number of track nodes.

articleTitle: Albert-based sentiment analysis of movie review
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Movie reviews include the real evaluation of the movie by the public. Through these reviews, the audience can better judge whether the movie is worth watching. However, as the amount of data on movie reviews continues to grow, it takes a lot of manpower and material resources to manually analyze the emotional tendency of each movie review. As an important research field of machine learning, sentiment analysis focuses on extracting topic information from text reviews. The field of sentiment analysis is closely related to natural language processing and text mining. It can be successfully used to determine the reviewer's attitude towards various topics or the overall polarity of the review. As far as movie reviews are concerned, in addition to scoring movies digitally, they can also quantitatively enlighten us on the advantages and disadvantages of watching movies. This article uses the Albert model to build a classifier, and uses the "movie review dataset" issued by Stanford University for network training. Experiments show that the trained Albert model can reach an accuracy of 89.05% when performing sentiment analysis of movie reviews. Compared with the traditional LSTM and GRU, the accuracy of the Albert model is improved by 3%.

articleTitle: Sentiment analysis of Amazon product reviews based on NLP
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: This is the age of information explosion. Numbers, text, video, and audio are all information. How to extract the instructive information we are interested in from a large amount of data is crucial. In this article, we built an evaluative model based on amazon product reviews. The review content is divided into good, medium, and bad to express the positive, negative and neutral emotions. From the basic information about the data, we find that the number of reviews is increasing exponentially. More and more consumers choose to shop online, among which beauty and baby products are more popular among consumers. To understand consumers' preferences, we use TextBlob, a natural language processing library in Python, to do word frequency statistics and sentiment analysis on product reviews. It is found from the word cloud that consumers are most concerned about the quality and price of products. The specific quality description of text-based Reviews - "love" is closely related to the rating level.

articleTitle: KYC Optimization by Blockchain Based Hyperledger Fabric Network
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: in financial institutions, the traditional Know Your Customer (KYC) process is insecure, and costly. The adoption of disruptive technology is a necessary condition for the coming future of financial institutions. This study proposed a Hyperledger Fabric network for KYC optimization. The Performance of the proposed system was tested by using the Hyperledger Composer. The experiment results confirm that due to the strong and identity features of Hyperledger Fabric, the proposed system can speed up the KYC clearing transfers, challenge the inefficiencies that arise from duplicated conduct of similar tasks, secure data sharing, cost-effective, and ultimately bring transparency in the traditional KYC system.

articleTitle: Energy-optimal Task Offloading algorithm of Resources Cooperation in mobile edge computing
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: With the development of mobile Internet era, mobile terminal equipment has become an indispensable tool in people's daily life. In order to improve the user experience and ease the endurance of mobile terminals, this paper studies the task offloading strategy for optimizing the energy consumption of mobile terminals. At present, most of the research only focuses on a single cloud offload and edge offload, and the research on reducing the energy consumption of mobile terminals is insufficient. In order to further reduce the energy consumption of mobile terminal equipment and improve the utilization of computing resources, this paper proposes a cloud-edge-terminal multi-computing resource cooperation task offloading model, and then designs a fitness calculation method for this model, and proposes a multi-computing resources cooperation energy optimization algorithm based on particle swarm optimization algorithm. Experiments show that, compared with the existing four offloading strategies, the proposed algorithm can fully reduce the energy consumption of mobile terminal devices while meeting the requirements of user delay, and has advantages in large-scale task offloading.

articleTitle: Traffic Flow Prediction Based on Improved SVR for VANET
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: For Vehicle Ad-Hoc Network (VANET), the accurate traffic flow information may offer useful guidance to drivers. In the past few years, applications of big data bring about opportunities for intelligent traffic control and management. This paper uses an optimization of support vector regression (SVM) as a way of traffic flow prediction. Particle swarm optimization (PSO) is applied to the parameter optimization of support vector regression (SVR), which improves the performance of the prediction system. The experimental results show that the method has good prediction effect.

articleTitle: Traffic Speed Prediction Based on LSTM-Graph Attention Network (L-GAT)
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: In recent years, with the rise of graph convolutional neural networks, traffic network prediction has become a hot topic. Affected by this, this paper proposes a new traffic network speed prediction method, named LSTM-Graph Attention Network (L-GAT). This method can not only capture the spatial characteristics of the traffic network, but also learn the time dynamics. In addition, we conducted experiments on the public data set of Didi, which proved that the L-GAT method is superior to other methods in traffic speed prediction.

articleTitle: The application prospects of NB-IoT in intelligent transportation
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) is a network that realizes the interconnection of people, machines, and things at anytime and anywhere, and the Narrow Band Internet of Things (NB-IoT) is an important branch of this Internet of Things. NB- IoT has the characteristics of wide coverage, massive connections, ultra-low power consumption, and ultra-low cost. Due to the above advantages of NB-IoT technology, the application of this technology in the field of intelligent transportation can fundamentally reduce traffic congestion and accidents. This article analyzes and introduces an intelligent transportation system based on NB-IoT technology, as well as some applications of NB-IoT in the field of intelligent transportation, and finally analyzes the advantages and future expectations of NB-IoT technology.

articleTitle: Lightweight Multi-Scale Network with Attention for Facial Expression Recognition
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of the traditional convolutional neural network (CNN), such as too many parameters, single scale feature and inefficiency by some useless features, a lightweight multi-scale network with attention is proposed for facial expression recognition. The network uses the lightweight convolutional neural network model Xception and combines with the convolutional block attention module (CBAM) to learn key facial features; In addition, depthwise separable convolution module with convolution kernel of 3 × 3, 5 × 5 and 7 × 7 are used to extract features of facial expression image, and the features are fused to expand the receptive field and obtain more rich facial feature information. Experiments on facial expression datasets Fer2013 and KDEF show that the expression recognition accuracy is improved by 2.14% and 2.18% than the original Xception model, and the results further verify the effectiveness of our methods.

articleTitle: The zero trust security platform for data trusteeship
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Cloud storage is a low-cost and convenient storage method, but the nature of cloud storage determines the existence of security risks for data uploaded by users. In order to ensure the security of users' data in third-party cloud platforms, a zero trust security platform for data trusteeship is proposed. The platform introduces the concept of zero trust, which meets the needs of users to upload sensitive data to untrusted third-party cloud platforms by implementing multiple functional modules such as sensitivity analysis service, cipher index service, attribute encryption service.

articleTitle: Based on the improved Deeplabv3 + remote sensing image semantic segmentation algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: As a new technology, remote sensing originated in the 1960s. In recent years, with the rapid progress of remote sensing satellite and computer hardware equipment, the number and ways of remote sensing image acquisition are increasing day by day. Due to the different sizes of remote sensing images, which are easily affected by the complex environment, this paper proposes a semantic segmentation algorithm based on the improved deeplabV3 +. In this paper, we use the lightweight network mobilenetv3 to extract features, then use the hollow pyramid structure to expand the receptive field, and then use the global context to enhance the fusion of features. Finally, bilinear interpolation method is used to upsample the output feature image to obtain the pixel level prediction segmentation map, so as to ensure the accuracy of image segmentation. Experiments show that the data provided by CCF big data competition (high-definition remote sensing image of a city in southern China in 2015) has good segmentation results. The total accuracy is achieved and the ratio of intersection and merging is achieved.

articleTitle: Study of Hotel AI Application and Development Trends in 5G Era
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: As a strategic technology for science-technology revolution and industrial reform, Artificial Intelligence(AI) plays a significant role in China’s economic and social progress. From guest services, room experience, products selling to guest safety and health management, application of AI in hotels is rather effective. Also, at the same time of providing highly efficient, convenient and novel services to customers, it deals a heavy blow to traditional hotels. This paper, based on the present application of AI in the hotel industry, strives to explore AI’s development trends in this sector by combining 5G technology and features of hotel industry in post-epidemic era.

articleTitle: An algorithm for extracting the center of linear structured light fringe based on directional template
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: The center line of the line structured light stripe extraction is the key step in the process of laser measurement line structure. In the laser extraction process, a new method based on adaptive orientation template is proposed to extract subpixel of the center of optical stripe for the influence of the quality of light source and the inconsistent width of the image stripe on the object surface. This algorithm firstly determines the optical fringe region and calculates the width of each section of the fringe by contour detection. Then use the skeleton thinning method to obtain the coarse center of gravity of the laser stripes. According to the width of each cross section of the light stripe, generate a direction template of the corresponding size and find the normal vector direction of each point on the skeleton. Finally, the subpixel position of the fringe center is determined by gray gravity center method on the normal vector. The experimental results show that this method can eliminate the influence of non-uniform noise and has a better extraction effect on light fringe with non-uniform width.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Anti-misoperation Technology Applied to Substation One-button Sequential Control
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: In this paper, the application of intelligent anti-misoperation technology in substation one-button sequential control is studied. Firstly, an adaptive anti-misoperation verification technique for the one-button sequential control operation is proposed to judge the five-prevention system's information interaction relationship in one-sequential sequential control. The combined anti-misoperation logic based on the monitoring information of primary and secondary equipment is further studied, and a set of intelligent five-prevention systems suitable for the one-button sequential control operating system is developed. Finally, the intelligent lock control system structure and its application in one-key sequential control are studied and developed.

articleTitle: Multi Group Marine Predator Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: The Marine Predator algorithm is a nature-inspired optimization algorithm with a simple search mechanism and suffers from a lack of population diversity reduction in the late iteration. In order to enhance population diversity and avoid falling into local optima, we propose a multi-group marine predator algorithm. (MGMPA). In MGMPA, the population is divided into exploitation, equilibrium and exploration populations, and the number of each subpopulation is dynamically controlled. The useful information of populations and individuals is fully utilized through a weighted maximum likelihood estimation strategy. The effectiveness of MGMPA was verified by using several test functions of CEC2104.

articleTitle: IoT based smart farming system to reduce manpower, wastage of time & natural resources in both traditional & urban mega farming
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Water is one of the most fundamental requirements of agriculture. The lack of water due to population growth has risen in recent years. This then becomes an obstacle for everyone. The old irrigation scheme requires much water. In order to minimize the percentage of excess water available in irrigation, smart strategies are required. In any domain, from tiny and basic applications to broad and complex applications, we have seen a large market for the internet of things rise. In fact, Smart Irrigation is very complicated, but the combination of IoT with Smart wireless sensors brings with it a fantastic management framework. The sensor detects both the contents of water vapor and the temperature around the plant. If the water level dropped below the minimum demand, water sources from a water tank through a relay. The Soil Moisture Indicator tracks the ground moisture of a plant. The entire system is automated and calibrated to require a minimal amount of time and energy. A mega-farming operation can be tracked and regulated from a single position with this system.

articleTitle: A Novel Differential Multi-Bit Carbon Nanotube Through Silicon Vias
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of I/O limitation between layers in three-dimensional integrated circuits, a novel type of differential multi-bit carbon nanotube TSV is proposed. The equivalent circuit model of the structure is established in ADS. The simulation results of S parameters in ADS and HFSS can fit well. Compared with the traditional GSSG TSV and two kinds of novel two-bit TSVs (G-SS-G and GS-SG), the proposed differential multi-bit CNT TSV saves chip area, improves the integration density, and has superior anti-interference ability.

articleTitle: Based on random game Petri net model CPS risk assessment and defense decision of distribution network
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Due to the wide application of information and communication technology, modern power grid has become a multi-dimensional and heterogeneous complex system of real-time perception, dynamic control and information service, that is, power grid information physical fusion system (power grid CPS). In this context, this paper proposes a distribution network CPS risk assessment and defense decision method based on random game Petri net model under network attack. To attack in a random game theory for the underlying, using Petri network architecture of the CPS model of distribution network, through the study of the level of network risk analysis refining attack and defense measures, according to the offensive and defensive game proceeds the analysis of the matrix calculation and Nash equilibrium strategy value consideration network risk probability of different stages of change, on the basis of summing up formula calculation method obtained state risk value and develop "the allocation of resources, defense analysis and risk assessment" defense decision-making scheme, then, the better defense strategy is obtained. Finally, a case study was carried out to determine the risk nodes of the system considering the factors of network attack, and the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed method were verified by optimizing the cutting load.

Author Keywords: Petri net model of random game

articleTitle: co-STM text categorization method based on Supervised Topic Model
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Traditional text classification methods are only trained on homogeneous data with uniform sample distribution and complete category labeling. With the rapid development of computer-related technology, today's data has the characteristics of diverse carrier forms, lack of label data, and unbalanced categories. As a result, traditional text classification technologies can no longer meet the requirements of today's text classification. Aiming at the new characteristics of data, this paper proposes a co-STM (collaborative text classification combined with Supervised Topic Model) collaborative text classification algorithm that integrates SLDA (Supervised LDA) supervised topic model. For category imbalance data, this paper adopts a confidence calculation method based on posterior probability distance and a category-based unlabeled sample selection strategy to select credible unlabeled samples. Comparative experiment results show that the co-STM text classification algorithm can effectively improve the performance of semi-supervised text classification.

articleTitle: Credit decision of SMEs based on Improved TOPSIS and decision tree
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Objective: To study the credit decision-making of SMEs. Methods: ① evaluation model establishment: through AHP, PCA, decision tree and other methods, the improved TOPSIS credit risk quantitative evaluation model based on AHP, the enterprise loan demand model based on PCA, and the bank hierarchical risk prevention and control model were established to make decisions for the enterprises with credit rating. Then, it makes a quantitative analysis of the credit risk, makes a credit decision to maximize the bank's income, and gives the error and result analysis. First of all, through the crawler, we obtained 600 pieces of data about the average monthly sales, average monthly input, the strength of upstream and downstream enterprises, and the number of buyer returns. Secondly, the modified TOPSIS credit risk quantitative evaluation model is established to analyze the above five factors and the credit rating of the enterprise, and the probability of the enterprise's discredit is obtained. Then, the hierarchical risk prevention and control model is established, and the principal component analysis method is used to quantify the strength of the enterprise, so as to obtain the loan amount of the enterprise. Finally, the credit strategy to maximize the bank's income is formulated, and the bank's profit margin is 4.94%. ② Generalization training: Taking enterprises without credit rating as training samples, the decision tree and support vector machine are used for training and testing respectively, and the correct rate of decision tree is 90.44%, which is better than 81.59% of support vector machine. Secondly, combined with five kinds of data, the credit risk<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup> quantitative evaluation model of TOPSIS is used to solve the credit failure probability of Unrated enterprises. Through the hierarchical risk prevention and control model, the loan interest rate of the enterprise is calculated, and the multiple nonlinear programming is transformed into linear programming for solution, so as to obtain the optimal credit strategy, which can make the annual profit rate of the bank reach 9.5%. Conclusion: after getting the five factors of small and medium-sized micro enterprises, we can judge the credit rating of enterprises through decision tree and make credit decision.

articleTitle: Simplified-TCA: A Simplified TCA Algorithm for Charging Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Wireless rechargeable sensors network (WRSN) provides a new approach to solve the energy scarcity problem in wireless sensor networks. The TCA algorithm is a new charging algorithm proposed for WRSN, selecting and deploying static chargers to automatically charge mobile devices while maximizing the charging quality of the network. However, TCA does not consider the movement features of mobile devices in a practice charging scenario, which leads to high computational complexity. To address the above problems, in this paper, we propose a simplified TCA algorithm called STCA to optimize the input of the algorithm and the utility function of the charging quality based on the original TCA algorithm. The simulation results show that the performance of our algorithm is similar to TCA, but the time of charger selection is much shorter than that of the original TCA algorithm.

articleTitle: Multiple Underwater Magnetic Targets Location Method Based on Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: The problem of locating magnetic target is the solution of nonlinear programming problems. The biggest characteristic of the problem is that the calculation process of the objective function is quite complicated. With the increase of the number of magnetic targets, the more unknowns need to be solved, which increase a lot of calculation. However, the speed of the objective function calculation could have a great influence on the real-time performance of the magnetic target location. Thus, this paper proposes an multiple underwater magnetic targets location method based on the neural network, which can get the position coordinates of the magnetic target without solving the objective function. Finally, the experimental results show that the magnetic target position obtained by this method has high accuracy and good real-time performance.

articleTitle: Development of Semi-virtual Simulation Training Platform Based on PLC
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: This design is based on PLC and configuration software, which developed a semi-virtual simulation training system. Through the software simulation of PLC control object, we can get a visual demonstration effect, and it provided a platform for the practice teaching of PLC.

articleTitle: AGV scheduling system based on MQTT protocol
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: This paper describes the AGV scheduling system based on mqtt protocol. The traditional AGV scheduling system uses TCP protocol to communicate with nodes directly, which takes up the resources of the system operation greatly when there are many nodes. This system is developed twice based on opentcs platform, and an AGV scheduling system based on mqtt communication protocol is designed. Redis database is used to cache mqtt subscription messages, and a b/s based management system is developed to analyze user requests to create transport tasks and visual factory overview. It provides various ways to create transportation tasks, connect ERP and MES systems to realize automatic scheduling function; intelligent equipment installed in station provides users with request operation function; in case of emergency, administrators can quickly create transportation tasks through management system. The result of the test proves that the communication line connected with mqtt server is needed to exchange all data with multiple nodes.

articleTitle: Online detection system for electric bike in elevator or corridors based on multi-scale fusion
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: The traditional elevator building room electric vehicle monitoring system adopts manual monitoring, which has disadvantages such as easy fatigue of personnel and difficulty in monitoring each video channel; to address this situation, we propose an online detection system for elevator building room electric vehicles based on the improved YOLOv4-tiny algorithm, which first crawls pictures of electric vehicles as positive samples, and crawls pictures with relevant backgrounds or similarity in order to reduce the error detection rate and leakage detection rate of the system. The experimental results show that the map of the online detection system based on the improved YOLOv4-tiny algorithm is 94.07%, which is about 2 percentage points higher than the original algorithm.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of Beidou Receiver Digital Correlator
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: In this paper, a Beidou correlator chip based on FPGA (Field Programmable Gate Array) is developed.Using the top-down design method, combined with the hardware programming language Verilog HDL, the function simulation of each module in the tracking channel of Beidou correlator is emphasized.The simulation results show that the theoretical analysis is consistent with the experimental results, and each module can be realized correctly and efficiently, in which the code tracking frequency resolution is 0.00908MHz, and the code phase error is 1/2 chip.It lays a good foundation for the development of Beidou receiver correlator chip.

articleTitle: Semi-supervised Anomaly Detection based on Improved Adversarial Autoencoder and Ensemble Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: We propose a novel anomaly detection method based on improved adversarial autoencoder and ensemble learning. Our method improves on the traditional adversarial autoencoder, and adds an encoder to extract additional feature vectors. The first set of feature vectors is extracted from the input image by the first encoder, and the output image is reconstructed by the decoder. Additional encoders use this reconstructed image to extract a second set of feature vectors. Two sets of feature vectors are weighted and fused to form a new set of feature vectors. Taking this new set of feature vectors as training data, AdaBoost algorithm is used to train and integrate several single-layer decision trees, and finally a strong classifier is obtained for anomaly detection. The proposed method has been verified and evaluated on several published image datasets, and has achieved excellent performance compared with the previous methods.

articleTitle: ArchivesChain:Distributed PKI Archives System
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Electronic archives are electronic files with very high security requirements. We use block chain technology to implement a distributed PKI system. On this basis, we build an archives system ArchivesChain based on block chain to solve the drawbacks of the current centralized storage of archives and the security problems caused by the excessive centralization of traditional PKI.We have implemented multi-point authentication of archive data through block chain technology, including certificate registration and verification confirmation when archives are generated, ensuring data security during the process of receiving and migrating archives, and generating archive certificates on the chain, similar to handling identity cards for each electronic file.Compared with CA authentication systems in traditional PKI, the block chain-based PKI in our system is provided by all members of the Federation to verify and authenticate the data, thus ensuring that archives information can not be tampered with and providing authentic authentication with credibility.

articleTitle: Research on control strategy based vehicle-network coupling instability suppression measures
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: In recent years, more and more attention has been paid to the safe and stable operation of electrified railway, especially to the vehicle-network coupling stability, which focuses on the phenomena of high frequency resonance (HFR) and low frequency oscillation (LFO), which has become the research hotspot. Firstly, this paper studies the impedance model of the traction network and the train power system, and proposes the AF-RCS impedance model of the vehicle-network. Based on this model, from the perspective of grid-side converter control strategy, AOC inhibition measures are proposed to solve the instability of vehicle-network coupling caused by insufficient system damping. Furthermore, VCT inhibition measures were proposed to quickly reduce the damage of HFR to the system. Finally, the VCT-AOC comprehensive suppression strategy was proposed, which improved the damping ratio and enhanced the stability of the system while rapidly protecting the system. The effectiveness of the method is verified by simulation and experiment.

articleTitle: Online Identification Technology Based on Variation Mechanism of Traction Motor Parameters
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: In this paper, a temperature sensorless parameter identification method based on DC signal injection is proposed, and a notch filter algorithm is proposed to solve the problem of DC bias signal acquisition. The DC signal injection method can be used to identify the stator and rotor resistance without depending on the motor model, and the accurate motor parameters can be obtained even in the case of motor fault. Finally, according to the variation mechanism of motor parameters, the online compensation strategy of motor parameters is proposed.

articleTitle: A Control Concept of SVM for Two Legs Inverters
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: In this paper, The SVM is proposed for single- phase sinewave inverters(two legs inverters). The proposed scheme structures 2-DOF vectors space based on four possible switching states and makes harmonic mitigation possible. In the structured vectors space, the reference vector is decoupled on two adjacent space vector directions with appropriate timing in order to provide an average output voltage during each switching period. The simulation study for the proposed approach was carried out and the effectiveness of the controller is verified by simulation results.

articleTitle: Forecast of Meteorological and Hydrological Features Based on SVR Model
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: With the global climate and the underlying surface changes, and high-intensity human activities intensified, meteorological and hydrological elements such as precipitation, evaporation, and runoff in the basin are directly affected. And the assumption of consistency in hydrological series no longer exists. In a changing environment, the applicability of traditional runoff forecasting methods has gradually deteriorated, which poses challenges to accurate meteorological and hydrological forecasts. In the aspects of multi-source precipitation data fusion, numerical weather prediction, watershed hydrological model, parameter calibration, data assimilation and ensemble forecasting, the research progress of meteorological and hydrological forecasting under the changing environment is reviewed. Domestic and foreign scholars have carried out a lot of researches on the above technologies. This paper mainly tells the characteristics of meteorological and hydrological data and carries out correlation analysis on the characteristics of meteorological and hydrological data. Then we obtain the correlation matrix between the characteristics. Finally in the SVR model, three different kernel functions linear, poly, rbf predictions are used for horizontal comparison to obtain a better prediction effect. The rbf kernel function is better, and then compared with the random forest regression prediction model, the conclusion is the SVR using the rbf kernel function has better predictive effect, and the predictive evaluation result is 0.898.

articleTitle: Noninvasive grading of glioma by knowledge distillation base lightweight convolutional neural network
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Convolutional neural network (CNN) has been applied to glioma classification, but there is no research result of CNN compression in this field. Lightweight CNN after compression provides the possibilities of deploying into a field programmable gate array (FPGA) or a memory limited hardware and further integrating into a medical electronic equipments. To solve the problem that CNNs are difficult to deploy to embedded devices and simple-scale CNNs have low accuracy in glioma grading, this paper proposes a method based on Knowledge Distillation to classify gliomas, and introduces an SE block into the model for improvement, so as to improve the performance with less parameters and computation. Inception -ResNet - V2 is chosen as the teacher model and SqueezeNet is chosen as the student model. The results showed that after knowledge distillation, accuracy, precision, recall rate, and F1-Score of the student model increased 3.53%, 5.68%, 3.73% and 4.69%, respectively. GPU usage, parameter number, FLOPs, and model size dropped by 35%, 98.72%, 98.7%, 98.62% respectively compared to the teacher model.

articleTitle: Research on fault location of BP neural network based on artificial fish swarm optimization
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Using the excellent global optimization ability of artificial fish schools, the initial weights and thresholds of the BP neural network can be adjusted to be near the global optimal value. This makes the BP neural network no longer randomly set the initial weights and Threshold, so that the network oscillation problem caused by randomly setting the initial weights and thresholds will no longer exist. The test results prove that the neural network optimized can effectively compensate the initial ranging result, improve the ranging accuracy, and achieve the purpose of accurately finding the fault location.

articleTitle: Optimization of general and special color rendering index with red quantum dots for white LEDs
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Synthesizing red-emitting phosphors with accurately controlled wavelength usually require harsh conditions such as high temperature and reductive atmosphere, which are the limitations for fabricating white light-emitting diodes (WLEDs) with high color rendering index. Here, we present the impact of adding red QD into WLED to improve value of Ra and R9.It is verified that the enhanced spectrum of R9 can achieve the display index above 90 by simulation and experiment.

articleTitle: Design of an automatic infant care system based on Arduino
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: In recent years, many young parents have the difficulties of high work pressure, little parenting experience and weak parenting ability, and even have negative emotions such as anxiety and uneasiness. According to reports, due to improper care, there are many cases of infant fracture, scald, gas poisoning, severe eczema and so on. In view of the above situation and people’s habit of using mobile phones, this paper designs an automatic infant care system based on Arduino. The system has the advantages of simple operation, low cost, wide range of users, and can detect temperature, humidity, harmful gases, heart rate, blood oxygen saturation, etc., aiming at providing the most intimate service for young families.

articleTitle: Research on intelligent service mode of digital library based on data intelligence
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: This paper introduces the concept and characteristics of data intelligence and digital library intelligent service, points out the characteristics of digital library intelligent service, and carries out the exploration of the construction method of digital library intelligent service mode based on data intelligence, so as to propose the implementation path of digital library intelligent service mode.

articleTitle: Influence of via holes on signal integrity of Multilayer PCB transmission lines
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: In this paper, the via hole of multi-layer PCB transmission lines is taken as the research object, and the signal integrity parameters including return loss, insertion loss and TDR impedance are analyzed by using three-dimensional electromagnetic simulation software CST Microwave Studio. The simulation results show that the back-drilling technology for through-holes is necessary to decrease the damage of the residual stub on the high-speed transmission and to reduce the difficulty of processing simultaneously. A grounding-hole added near the via is necessary to optimize the signal integrity parameters of the transmission line.

articleTitle: Application of Logistic Regression and Principal Component Analysis in TCM diagnosis and treatment
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Stata and python were used to analyze and clean the data of TCM diagnosis thyroid medical records. Principal component analysis and factor analysis were used to analyze and clean the symptoms and pathogenesis of the medical record data. The data in the prescription were quantified. The feature selection of the data set was performed by principal component analysis to reduce the data dimension. In the process of treatment, different kinds of prescriptions will be used. Association analysis algorithm in data mining is used to mine the association rules of prescription medication and complications of thyroid disease, which provides a reference for clinical treatment drug selection and disease prevention of traditional Chinese medicine. Logistic regression was used to establish the prediction model of traditional Chinese medicine diagnosis prescription of thyroid by using the clinical data of traditional Chinese medicine.

articleTitle: False Data Detection Based On LSTM Network In Smart Grid
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: In contrast to traditional grids, smart grids can help utilities save energy, thereby reducing operating costs. In the smart grid, the quality of monitoring and control can be fully improved by combining computing and intelligent communication knowledge. However, this will expose the system to FDI attacks, and the system is vulnerable to intrusion. Therefore, it is very important to detect such erroneous data injection attacks and provide an algorithm to protect the system from such attacks. In this paper, a FDI detection method based on LSTM has been proposed, which is validated by the simulation on the ieee-14 bus platform.

articleTitle: Research on Maximum Power Point Tracking Based on LSTM Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: With the large-scale promotion and application of new energy power generation, the problem of global energy shortage and environmental degradation has been solved. Among them, photovoltaic power generation is the main means. Improving the power generation efficiency of photovoltaic modules has become a research hotspot in the field of new energy. In actual scenarios, the working environment is complex, with data nonlinearity, feature sparseness and other problems. This paper introduces LSTM recurrent neural network and attention mechanism for maximum power point tracking, and uses Matlab/Simulink to build a photovoltaic system and conduct simulation experiments.

articleTitle: Target Classification Using Spiking Neural Networks for SAR Images
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Synthetic aperture radar (SAR) imagery is widely applied to recognize target ships in marine surveillance since it can operate in all-weather day-and-night conditions. Deep learning and neural networks have also been used more frequently in recent years with SAR data and have achieved significant progress. However, it takes a lot of energy for deep neural networks to learn and hinders the further development of SAR technology. Compared with the traditional deep neural networks, Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) have temporal information processing ability, low power consumption, and high biological plausibility, which are suitable for future radar intelligent sensing. In this paper, we take inspiration from SNNs and propose an energy-efficient method, namely SpikingSAR. The experimental results show that the proposed method outperforms the state-of-the-art deep learning methods as well as the conventional methods, while it also has fewer model parameters.

articleTitle: Recognition and Counting of Citrus Trees Based on UAV Images
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Accurate and rapid knowledge of the number of citrus trees is of great significance for predicting citrus yield, managing citrus growth and improving citrus yield. In this paper, the UAV is used to shoot the citrus planting area in Xinhui District of Jiangmen City. The visible light image obtained by the UAV is processed and analyzed by computer vision technology. The number of citrus trees in the shooting area can be accurately obtained, and the number of mature trees and saplings can be further counted. The accuracy rate is more than 95%.The results show that it can meet the requirements of fast and accurate acquisition of citrus trees in planting area at low cost.

articleTitle: Cogging Torque Optimization of Permanent Magnet Direct-driven Wind Turbine Generator
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: In order to improve the operation performance of 6-pole 72 slot permanent magnet direct-drive wind turbine, a method of reducing cogging torque by combining magnet segmentation with rotor auxiliary slot is proposed. According to the analytical formula and superposition principle of cogging torque, the effectiveness of magnetic pole block and rotor auxiliary slot on reducing cogging torque is analyzed. Based on Maxwell finite element software, the influence of the number of permanent magnet pole blocks and rotor slotting on cogging torque is studied, and the optimal number of magnetic pole blocks and the pole arc angle of the auxiliary circle of rotor slotting are obtained. By comparing and analyzing the simulation results of the motor before and after optimization, it can be seen that the cogging torque of the motor has been significantly reduced, and the sinusoidal characteristics of the air-gap flux density and the phase no-load back EMF are also improved.

Author Keywords: permanent magnet direct-driven wind turbine generator

articleTitle: Research on Adaptability Evaluation of Satellite Communication in Complex Electromagnetic Environment
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: According to the link characteristics of satellite communication, this paper clarifies the principles of selecting the evaluation index of the satellite communication complex electromagnetic environment adaptability before the adaptability evaluation, constructs the satellite communication electromagnetic environment evaluation index system, and proposes the evaluation method of the complex electromagnetic environment adaptability. With the development of communication satellite technology and the massive launch of communication satellites, Communication satellites are facing increasingly complex electromagnetic environments caused by intentional and unintentional interference, this complex spatial electromagnetic environment composed of a large number of electromagnetic signals with complex patterns, densely overlapping, and dynamic overlapping forms a severe test for the normal operation of communication satellites. Therefore, how to improve the adaptability of complex electromagnetic environment and the level of scientific evaluation, has become a key issue that needs to be solved urgently for communication satellites.

articleTitle: Research and Analysis of One-dimensional Discrete Wavelet Transform
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: In the digital information age, signal processing technology has become an increasingly popular research direction. Among them, discrete wavelet transform, which is widely used in signal analysis, image compression, and video coding, is an important research topic. In the process of multi-resolution analysis, each layer of decomposition causes the signal to pass through a low-pass filter and a band-pass filter, and the signal is decomposed into a low-frequency part and a high-frequency part. The characteristics of the low-pass filter are determined by the scaling function φ(x), and the characteristics of the band-pass filter are determined by the wavelet function ψ(x). The decomposed coefficient consists of two parts: low frequency coefficient vector cA and high frequency coefficient vector cD. The low frequency coefficient vector cA is obtained by convolution of the impulse response of the signal and the low-pass filter, which reflects the low frequency component of the signal. High-frequency coefficient vector cD is obtained by convolution of signal and bandpass filter, which reflects the high frequency component of signal.

articleTitle: Power load forecasting based on Improved Grey Model of particle swarm optimization
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Grey theory plays a very important role in the field of power load forecasting. In order to improve the forecasting accuracy of medium and long-term power load data, an improved grey model forecasting method based on particle swarm optimization is proposed. First of all, the data transformation technology is used to reduce the prediction error of discrete data using continuous function model in the prediction process. Then the Markov prediction model is used to predict the best state interval. Through particle swarm optimization algorithm, the parameters of the state interval are optimized, and then the prediction results are modified. The method is applied to the load forecasting of Sichuan Province from 2010 to 2011, and the results verify the superiority of the method in accuracy.

articleTitle: A Semantic Segmentation Method Based On Improved U-net Network
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Semantic segmentation is the most important branch of image processing. Semantic segmentation based on deep learning occupies the mainstream method. CNN, FCN, U-NET and DEEPLAB series have achieved good results in the field of image semantic segmentation. The improvement methods of each network also emerge in an endless stream, but the emphasis of improving the network focuses on the feature transfer and feature fusion between network layers in each method. In this paper, based on u-net, we use deep convolution, residual autonomic force and dendrite network to improve the network model. Deep convolution can reduce the amount of calculation, deepen the depth of network, extract more abundant image information, and transmit information between network layers in a more refined way. Dendritic networks are different from ordinary neural networks. Ordinary neural networks process information as models of nerve cell bodies. The role of neural dendrites is also important in the process of information processing. Dendritic network is used as a model of neural dendrites to improve the ability of information processing. The improved network in this paper was tested on the VOC2012 dataset, and the experimental results showed that PA, mAP and IoU were 93.36%, 92.28% and 68.26% respectively. The experimental results showed that the improved network in this paper had improved in all indicators.

articleTitle: Research on Solving Method of WTA Problem based on Firework Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of poor robustness, low search efficiency, and easy falling into local optima in solving the weapon target assignment (WTA) problem, an improved firework algorithm, IGFWA, is proposed. Based on the firework algorithm, a dimension-based explosion operator is designed, which balances the search quality and search efficiency of the explosion operator. The cross-mutation operator is introduced to replace the Gaussian mutation operator, which enhances the information exchange between fireworks individuals. The selection strategy based on the Hamming distance is proposed, which ensures the diversity of fireworks populations and accelerates the algorithm's convergence ability. The experiment results show IGFWA has better robustness and stronger global optimization capability compared with genetic algorithm and firework algorithm, especially when in large-scale WTA problems.

articleTitle: Fast CNC Milling Simulation Based on Local Permutation Embedding Sequences
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: This paper presents a method for fast rendering of CNC milling which is based on the previous techniques using the Permutation Embedding Sequence (PES). To reduce the total length of the PES, the viewing frustum is subdivided and the rendering is performed by generating sub-images in each sub-window. The swept volumes of the milling tools are also subdivided into sub-volumes such that the number of volumes related to a sub-window becomes much less, which leads to greatly reduced length of PES. The advantage of the proposed algorithm is that rendering is only performed according to the relevance between the object and the viewing frustum, which avoids unnecessary rendering of objects that are irrelevant to the frustum. By comparing with the traditional method through some experiments, it shows that the proposed strategy improves the efficiency of rendering considerably.

articleTitle: Analysis and Design of Graduation Design Management System Based on DES Encryption Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: This paper focuses on the analysis of the System Use Case Model and business process logic by using software engineering methods and UML modeling tools. In the system design stage, role-based access control (RBAC) is introduced to associate roles and permissions with the full consideration of the system’s compatibility and scalability. In terms of security design, by consulting the DES encryption process, the extended permutation and S-box transformation function in the Feistel algorithm are used to encrypt and decrypt sensitive system data.

articleTitle: Research on security of NB-IoT based on cryptography
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: With the application of intelligent networking device more and more common, narrow-band Internet of things has gradually become the preferred form of medium and long-distance Internet of things device. In the application process of massive and multi type Internet of things devices, the data is vulnerable to eavesdropping, tampering, interception and other threats, so it is necessary to encrypt and protect the whole process of data from data source output to visual display. This paper studies the data flow of NB-IoT, proposes a secure Internet of things scheme based on cryptography, and puts forward some ideas for the practical application of NB-IoT.

articleTitle: Research on Non-stationary Acoustic Signal Filtering Method Based on Wavelet Threshold Denoising
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: In order to deal with the noise problem in the process of acquiring sound information, wavelet analysis method is used in this paper: (1) The traditional wavelet analysis method has the problems of "overkill" and large deviation of the reconstructed signal. By analyzing the wavelet decomposition process and fitting the change of the noise with the decomposition layer, a dynamic threshold calculation method is proposed, which optimized the signal excessive filtering problem; (2) A new threshold function is designed by fusing the characteristics of the soft threshold function and the hard threshold function. The characteristic curve presents a smooth and gradually increasing characteristic of concave function, which solves the problem of large deviations in reconstructed signals. The experimental comparison of signal-to-noise ratio and root mean square error shows that the designed method in this paper can improve the accuracy of signal recognition and has higher application value in processing one-dimensional non-stationary signals.

articleTitle: Accelerating Level 2 BLAS Based on ARM SVE
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Scalable Vector Extension (SVE) is a special vector instruction set architecture recently released by ARM, which is a vector extension for A64 instruction set of ARMv8-A architecture. SVE introduces many significant features that not only take full advantage of the use of wide vector, but also enable efficient vectorization functions which can realize high performance. This paper described how to apply the main features of SVE to accelerate the Level 2 BLAS routines. We carried out the simulation on ARM Instruction Emulator (ARMIE) and Gem5 simulator. The results demonstrated that our SVE implementation reduced the number of executed instructions by 90% and achieved over 17x speedup compared with the NEON implementation.

articleTitle: A method of obtaining high quality PPG signal based on approximate entropy
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: In practice, PPG signal is often interfered by background light, movement, individual differences and other factors. When the interference is very serious, it is difficult to get the available PPG signal by filtering. If we continue to measure all kinds of physiological parameters on such signals, the calculation results will be inaccurate. Due to the individual differences of the tested population, the different parts of the tested will also cause the difference of the signal quality, because the two pairs of sensors are placed in different parts of the human body surface, and the group with better PPG signal quality is selected based on the judgment of the characteristic parameter approximate entropy. The obtained PPG signal can be used to calculate physiological parameters with higher accuracy.

articleTitle: Design of Self-Refresh bitstream based on FPGA dynamic local reconfiguration
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: This article first introduces the implementation of FPGA dynamic partial reconfiguration, combined with the space radiation environment’s demand for FPGA configuration refresh, and analyzes the advantages and disadvantages of different refresh control systems. According to the understanding of the FPGA bitstream structure, this paper proposes a Self-Refresh bitstream design scheme based on FPGA dynamic partial reconfiguration and designs the corresponding bitstream. The simulation results show that the bitstream design scheme is easy to implement in FPGA and significantly reduces the refresh time.

articleTitle: Grey-box Fuzzing With Deep Reinforcement Learning And Process Trace Back
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Grey-box fuzzing, as a software testing technique, can find possible program bugs such as memory leaks, assertion failures and invalid input by generate random data then input it into a program, and monitor program exceptions. With program running, grey-box fuzzing collected the branch information in order to guide choosing next seeds. In this paper, we try to use the concept of Markov decision processes to formalize grey-box fuzzing as a deep reinforcement learning problem, and use process trace back(Intel Process Trace) to collect branch information in order to improve its efficiency toward binary programs. The experiments show this approach can outperform baseline random fuzzing and gain performance improvement.

articleTitle: Identification of critical nodes in power system under the influence of new energy sources
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: In order to make the system more random and volatile when renewable energy and active load are connected to the grid, a method for identifying vulnerable nodes of the grid considering the influence of new energy sources is proposed. First of all from the grid network topology, power grid node failure risk, expected failure impact from three aspects, the construction of power grid node vulnerability assessment index, and then, based on very Latin sampling probability trend, in the form of interval instead of certain values to reflect the fragility of the node, in the end, the three parameters interval number based on Boolean matrix sequencing methods identify system vulnerable node. An example of IEEE39 node system proves the rationality and effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Salp Swarm Algorithm based Semi-supervised Metric Fuzzy Clustering
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Semi-supervised Metric Fuzzy Clustering (SMUC) is known for taking advantage of prior information of membership to guide clustering. However, SMUC has the following problem: it is very easy to lead to lower utilization effect of prior information of membership due to sensitivity to the initial cluster centers. In order to solve the problem, we propose a hybrid approach for Salp Swarm Algorithm based Semi-supervised Metric Fuzzy Clustering (SSA-SMUC). Firstly, several data samples were randomly selected as the salp population from all data samples to obtain the optimal initial cluster centers. Secondly, the optimal initial cluster centers are obtained by the Salp Swarm Algorithm using the DB index as its fitness function. Finally, applying the optimal cluster centers as the initial cluster centers of SMUC for clustering, we can improve SMUC's utilization effect of prior information and get the better clustering result. Further experiments conducted in UCI data show that the proposed clustering algorithm can derive a better performance.

articleTitle: Research on Error Characteristic and Error Influence Quantity of Instrument Current Transformer by Using Different Verification Methods
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Based on the designed error verification platform of three-phase combined transformer, the error characteristic of current transformer (CT) unit in three-phase instrument combined transformer is measured. The error influence quantities are also given by a comparison and analysis with single-phase and three-phase verification methods, which including the influences induced by the three phases of the instrument combined transformer simultaneously up-current and both PT and CT are excited at the same time. The results show that the size of the secondary load has a certain influence on its error characteristics, and CT shows different error characteristics under rated load and lower limit load. The three phases of CT unit up-current at the same time only has little influence on its error characteristics. However, if PT unit is in excitation state at the same time, the error of CT at the test points with small current (<20% rated current) increases greatly; especially the phase angle error is even out of tolerance.

articleTitle: Application of LADRC Algorithm in Energy-saving Heating Control System
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: In view of the increasingly strong awareness of energy conservation and environmental protection and the increasing status of building energy conservation, based on the LADRC control algorithm, combined with ZigBee wireless communication technology, M-Bus bus transmission technology and Web configuration software, a design of an energy-saving heating control system is proposed. The program realizes automatic room temperature adjustment, heat monitoring, data transmission and remote monitoring. This design uses ZigBee and M-Bus technology to transmit the data collected by the sensor to the control module, and then uses the LADRC control algorithm to calculate the control value of the valve, and then controls the valve to maintain the room temperature within the set temperature range, and transmit various data to the server for remote monitoring of heating automatic control. This design scheme can save energy, reduce pollution and improve the quality of life in the heating system, and can provide effective data to ensure the rationality and fairness of heating charges, and has good engineering significance and practical value.

articleTitle: An improved Harris Hawk algorithm based on Golden Sine mechanism
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Harris Hawk algorithm has received a lot of attention due to its few control parameters, simplicity and practicality. However, there are still some shortcomings, such as the problem of slow convergence, and hard to maintain the balance between exploration and exploitation when dealing with complex multimodal problems. Therefore, we introduce the golden sine mechanism into the Harris Hawk algorithm, called GSHHO, to enhance the global search capability. Experiments on the benchmark function show that the improved algorithm can effectively enhance the population diversity and its performance is better than the original algorithm.

articleTitle: A dynamic resource management model of Internet of things based on service migration : State Grid Corporation of China headquarters science and technology project funding
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: With the development of Internet of things and mobile computing, users can access to the network in different places and in different scenarios. In order to make Internet of things users have better service experience, this paper proposes a distributed service migration mode (DSMM) for dynamic management of Internet of things resources. DSMM can dynamically migrate services in the whole network according to the user's access location and access scenario, so as to make the user’s service experience better. DSMM uses computing power, storage space, network bandwidth and data to define user services, and uses distributed hash table DHT to realize service migration without center, which can be used in large networks. DSMM proposed in this paper enhances the adaptability of Internet of things to provide services to users, and is an efficient dynamic resource management model for Internet of things.

articleTitle: Time parameter measurement system for alternating current filament relay of railway signal lamp
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Aiming at the tedious maintenance work of ac filament conversion relay of railway signal lamp unit, this paper designs a new online detection device for relay working state. By switching relay paths and relying on the collected data, contact voltage image fitting is performed during the conversion process, and time parameters are extracted by different method to obtain the conversion time. Compared with the traditional detection device, the operation and detection time of the device is short, flexible and convenient.

articleTitle: Recognition of ECG Signals by Convolutional Neural Network Based on Attentional Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: In this paper, a deep network model based on attentional mechanism is proposed to realize ECG recognition. The model is based on convolutional neural network, which is composed of four convolutional layers and full connection layers. In order to improve the performance of feature extraction by convolutional neural network, an attention mechanism module is embedded behind the pooling layer of the first convolutional neural network. The feature maps from output by the pooling layer are sent to the channel domain module and the spatial domain module respectively to generate attention maps. The attention maps assign different weights to the feature maps to complete the re-extraction of ECG signal features and realize adaptive feature refinement. The characteristics of ECG signal were further enhanced through two dimensions. Considering the characteristics of ECG signals and the hard coding characteristics of convolutional neural network calculation, S-transform is used to establish two-dimensional ECG time-frequency matrix images for different time-sequence ECG signals, which is more conducive to signal recognition. Using the MIT/BIH arrhythmia database set of ECG signals, six different ECG signals were identified and classified, this model was verified 5-fold cross validation on the testing set, recognition accuracy is above 99.59%.

articleTitle: Vehicle Taillamp Intention Recognition for Intelligent and Connected Vehicles Based on YOLOv4
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: In order to achieve fast and accurate vehicle taillamp intention recognition for intelligent and connected vehicles, a taillamp intention recognition method based on the YOLOv4 algorithm was proposed. Firstly, the images of the vehicles in different lamping conditions during driving were collected, and the corresponding dataset was established for training and testing the model. Then the input parameter was modified, and the cosine annealing learning rate algorithm was applied to the YOLOv4 framework. Experimental result showed that this method had an accuracy of 90.27% for vehicle taillamp intention recognition and a detection rate of 20fps. This method can realize the intention recognition of vehicle taillamps, and provide a basis for driving decision-making of intelligent and connected vehicles.

articleTitle: A Neural Model for Aspect-Level Sentiment Classification of Product Reviews Assissted by Question-Answering
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Aspect-level sentiment analysis targets at judging the associated polarity of the opinion holder’s view towards given aspect category, and it usually contains two sub-tasks, namely aspect term extraction and aspect-related sentiment classification. However, the aspect term extraction, an auxiliary sub-task, receives too much emphasis, and it is labor-consuming. With the development of deep learning theory and language models, quite a few problems in natural language processing (NLP) domain have been solved. To address the problems mentioned above, we propose to remove the aspect term extraction component and regard aspect categories as guidelines to apply the question answering theory. Simultaneously, we utilize BERT as the base support unit to sufficiently encode the context information. For the purpose of evaluating our method, we also construct our Chinese review corpus for aspect-level sentiment analysis assignment. Experimental results show that our proposed method achieves an appreciable performance on our dataset.

articleTitle: Capacity Evaluation Method for Integrated Electric Vehicles Considering Operational Constraints
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: With the mushroom growth of electric vehicles (EVs), a large number of EV charging stations have been established. Regarded as a charging load, the access of EVs posts challenges to the balance of supply and demand with safe operational constraints in distribution networks. This paper proposes a capacity evaluation method to capture the feasible region of EV charging stations, which can guide for the choice of charging station, without threatening to distribution networks. Considering the coupling effect of charging stations, a set of objective functions related to the charging capacity of every EV charging station is constructed. The objective functions can approximate the feasible region of the charging station subjected to the operational constraints, including power balance equations, transmission capacity limits, generation capacity limits, and voltage limits. The effectiveness of the method is demonstrated by test results on the IEEE 33-bus system.

articleTitle: Multi-objective Reservoir Optimal Operation Based on GCN and NSGA-II Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: The problem of reservoir flood control operation is a multi-objective optimization problem. In order to solve this problem, a new algorithm based on graph convolution neural network and fast non-dominated sorting genetic algorithm II (GCN_NSGA-II) is proposed in this paper. When NSGA-II algorithm is used to solve multi-objective optimization problems, its convergence speed will slow down when the iteration reaches a certain algebra. In order to speed up the convergence speed, we use genetic algorithm to simulate the reproduction process of biological population. There is a relationship between parents and offspring. By means of group coding, the tree structure of the parents and children is transformed into a graph structure, and the GCN is trained and the graph nodes are classified, and the Pareto solution set can be obtained more quickly. In order to further ensure the integrity and uniformity, the NSGA-IIalgorithm is used to adjust it. The performance index IGD is used to measure the algorithm in the process. This algorithm speeds up the convergence speed and ensures the uniformity of Pareto solution set. The effectiveness of the algorithm in this paper is verified on the Xiaolangdi Reservoir flood control and dispatching problem.
