Compared with the NSGA-II and NSGA-DE algorithms, for the same index value, the number of iterations of the GCN_NSGA-II algorithm is significantly reduced and the convergence speed is significantly accelerated.

articleTitle: Improved Depth Neural Network Industrial Control Security Algorithm Based On PCA Dimension Reduction
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: In order to improve the security and anti-interference ability of industrial control system, this paper proposes an improved industrial neural network defense method based on the PCA dimension reduction and the improved deep neural network. Firstly, the proposed method reduces the dimensionality of the industrial data using the dimension reduction theory of principal component analysis (PCA). Then the deep neural network extracts the features of the network. Finally, the softmax classifier classifies industrial data. Experiment results show that compared with unintegrated algorithm, this method achieves higher recognition accuracy and has great application potential.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study of Financial Factor Mining Based on Gene Expression Programming
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Financial factor mining has important theoretical significance and practical value for further improving the investor's rate of return, but it has always been manually mining. Automatic mining of investment factors by genetic algorithm can better realize the preliminary work of finding factors, understanding factors, and applying factors. This paper proposes a method based on gene expression programming (GEP) to mine the relationship between data and establish the predictive model, and the optimization goal is the return rate after the next 5 trading days. The empirical research on the financial factor mining through genetic optimization method has achieved certain results and the experimental results have been analyzed.

articleTitle: Research on Framework of Smart Grid Data Secure Storage from Blockchain Perspective
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: With the development of technology, the structure of power grid becomes more and more complex, and the amount of data collected is also increasing. In the existing smart power grid, the data collected by sensors need to be uploaded and stored to the trusted central node, but the centralized storage method is easy to cause the malicious attack of the central node, resulting in single point failure, data tampering and other security problems. In order to solve these information security problems, this paper proposes a new data security storage framework based on private blockchain. By using the improved raft algorithm, partial decentralized data storage is used instead of traditional centralized storage. It also introduces in detail the working mechanism of the smart grid data security storage framework, including the process of uploading collected data, data verification, and data block consensus. The security analysis shows the effectiveness of the proposed data storage framework.

articleTitle: esearch on Credit Card Fraud Classification Based on GA-SVM
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Credit card transaction data belongs to imbalanced data. It is necessary to identify whether the credit card is at risk of fraud by analyzing the previous transaction data, so as to deal with the risk in time. Aiming at the problem that a traditional classifier cannot achieve good results in dealing with imbalanced data classification, a Support Vector Machine (SVM) model optimized by Genetic Algorithm (GA) is proposed in this paper. First, cluster centroids sampling is used to make the dataset relatively balanced. Second, we employ GA to optimize the parameters of the SVM and select optimal features of the data to improve the classification performance. The Area Under Receiver Operating Characteristic (ROC) Curve (AUC) and accuracy serve as classification evaluation indicators. Compared with traditional classifiers, accuracy and AUC value have been improved by GA-SVM. Compared to Random Forest, Logistic Regression and Naive Bayes classification, GA-SVM has improved the accuracy by 2.03%, 5.14% and 6.89%, respectively. On the AUC value, it is increased by 2.00%, 5.36% and 6.93%, respectively. These results show that GA-SVM can improve the overall accuracy and optimize the performance of the classifier on the credit card fraud recognition.

articleTitle: Credit Evaluation Model of Small and Micro Enterprises' Financing Risk Based on Modified BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: With the development of the Internet, small and micro enterprises have developed rapidly and have become an important driving force for social and economic development. Therefore, it is particularly important to establish a sound financing risk evaluation system. This article is based on the big data analysis environment, combined with the direction of financial big data and data mining. The BP neural network model is transformed, and the loss function is transformed from the basic cross-entropy form to the Focal Loss function that can control the weight of positive and negative samples. Such improvements make the evaluation model more suitable for the characteristics of indicators and the actual development of small and micro enterprises. The small and micro enterprise financing risk reputation evaluation model established in this paper can be used as reference information for financial institutions to invest in small and micro enterprises, and promote the establishment of a good credit cooperation relationship between financial institutions and small and micro enterprises.

Author Keywords: Small and micro enterprise risk assessment

articleTitle: Design of Automatic Cruise System for Distribution Network Equipment Based on Small UAV
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: In order to improve the real-time performance of automatic cruise system for distribution network equipment, an automatic cruise system for distribution network equipment based on Small UAV is designed. Through the main control chip, GPS module, micromachined gyroscope, micromachined accelerometer, magnetometer, barometric altimeter, airspeed meter, clock and reset circuit, the hardware of the system is designed. In the software part of the system, the detection management, inspection automation and route planning are studied to complete the design of automatic cruise system for distribution network equipment based on Small UAV. The experimental results show that the automatic cruise system of distribution network equipment based on Small UAV has better real-time performance and shorter cruise time than the traditional system, which meets the system design requirements.

articleTitle: Research on 360° 3D point cloud reconstruction technology based on turntable and line structured light stereo vision
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: In order to obtain the 360° contour feature and size of a processed workpiece, a 360 ° 3D point cloud reconstruction technology based on turntable and line structured light stereo vision is proposed. The technical research is to use the turntable to rotate the object to realize the 360° scan of the object by the line laser, and the camera captures the 360° three- dimensional point cloud data of the object surface, which solves the problem of the angle of view that the object surface and the surface block each other. The axis coordinate system of the rotating shaft is calibrated by the three-dimensional target, and the 360° three-dimensional point cloud data obtained is spliced under the axis coordinate system of the rotating table to realize the three-dimensional reconstruction of the object. Experimental results show that this measurement method is simple to operate, easy to implement, and has a certain measurement accuracy, with a measurement accuracy of 0.5 mm.

articleTitle: Design of information sy stem model management system based on micro-service
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of high coupling degree and poor flexibility of the traditional information system model management system in the process of use and update, a system architecture design method based on micro-service was proposed. Firstly, a solution based on micro-service technology architecture is proposed. Then, according to the reality of the system, the requirements of various aspects are analyzed, and the overall architecture of the system and the system architecture based on micro-service are proposed. At last, the function modules of the system and the key technologies of the system are introduced. This system design method can well solve the related problems of model management in the process of information system construction, and it is of great significance to the improvement of information system function.

articleTitle: System online upgrade scheme based on FPGA reconfiguration
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: This article first introduces two implementation methods of Virtex-7 series FPGA reconfiguration, and then combines two implementation methods according to their characteristics, proposes an online upgrade solution based on FPGA reconfiguration. Finally, according to the scheme design, simulation results show that the online upgrade scheme can ensure that the FPGA chip will not cause functional failure after the online upgrade.

articleTitle: A Rapid Automatic Exposure Technology for Micro-Nano Remote Sensing Camera
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Micro-nano remote sensing cameras have been used more and more widely in the areas of spacecraft on-orbit motion monitoring, ground intelligent remote sensing, and extraterrestrial object detection by virtue of their advantages such as small size, light weight, strong functions, good reliability, and convenient use. In order to achieve good imaging effect, automatic exposure technology adapted to complex space scenes is indispensable. In this paper, a fast adaptive exposure algorithm is proposed for the spatial scenes and convenient implementation. The algorithm is based on the post-block image entropy for image analysis, weighting statistics on the target according to the statistics of the image, and using the lookup table method to calculate the optimal exposure time. The experimental results show that the algorithm can obtain the best exposure time quickly and stably. The speed of exposure is fast and the stability is high. It is very suitable for on-orbit application of micro-nano remote sensing camera. The correlation algorithm has been successfully applied to multiple on-orbit models.

articleTitle: Research on automatic generation of test data for multi-path coverage
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Software testing is a complex and time-consuming task, especially in the part of test case design. Therefore, test automation can greatly reduce the consumption of manpower and material resources. The main work of this paper is as follows:1This article designs a total path similarity for the target path group of the code from the perspective of multi-path oriented. And relying on this to generate test data that meets multiple target paths at one time, so as to reduce the number of iterations and time spent.2This article is inspired by the fitness function design of genetic algorithm, and designs a fitness evaluation method for multi-path and single-path.3This paper selects the Beetle Antennae Search algorithm from existing intelligent optimization algorithms. Because it does not require too much information, it performs very well in low- dimensional problems, and only needs one longhorn beetle in the search process, which greatly reduces the amount of calculation. And it is applied to the triangle classification problem program, and compared with the traditional genetic algorithm at the same time. The experimental results verify the correctness of the method, and the Beetle Antennae Search algorithm is more efficient than the genetic algorithm.

articleTitle: Research and Design of Automatic Parking System Based on Wechat Applet
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: With the development of economy, the demand for cars in our country is increasing. The traffic congestion and parking difficulties in cities make people headache. Especially in some public places, such as shopping malls, hospitals and other densely populated places, parking is particularly difficult. To solve the problem of parking, many shopping malls also use some automatic parking management systems. These systems have different concerns, different directions and uneven solutions. Although some difficulties have been solved, there are still some regrets. Based on this situation, it is necessary to design an autonomous parking system. This system is based on network technology, GIS technology, sensor technology, license plate recognition technology to develop an independent parking wechat small program, which can better solve some of the people's demands.

articleTitle: Internet of things device recognition method based on natural language processing and text similarity
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Effective identification of Internet of things devices in cyberspace is of great significance to the protection of Cyberspace Security. However, there are a large number of such devices in cyberspace, which can not be identified by the existing methods of identifying IoT devices because of the lack of key information such as manufacturer name and device name in the response message. Their existence brings hidden danger to Cyberspace Security. In order to identify the IoT devices with missing key information in these response messages, this paper proposes an IoT device identification method, IoTCatcher. IoTCatcher uses HTTP response message and the structure and style characteristics of HTML document, and based on natural language processing technology and text similarity technology, classifies and compares the IoT devices whose response message lacks key information, so as to generate their device finger information. This paper proves that the recognition precision of IoTCatcher is 95.29%, and the recall rate is 91.01%. Compared with the existing methods, the overall performance is improved by 38.83%.

articleTitle: Research on mapping method based on data fusion of lidar and depth camera
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: At present, mobile robots equipped with a single sensor in an indoor environment suffer from insufficient mapping accuracy and limited scanning range. Therefore, this paper proposes a method for data fusion mapping with three sensors, single-line lidar, depth camera and IMU. First, the depth data collected by the depth camera is reduced by dimensionality processing to make it two-dimensional, and then the environmental feature data scanned in the lidar, the pseudo laser data of the depth camera, and the pose information collected and calculated by the IMU are passed through Kalman. Filtering performs data fusion, that is, compensating the position and attitude errors caused by the lidar measurement. In the mapping phase, under the open source SLAM algorithm Gmapping, the two-dimensional local raster maps generated by the lidar that fuse multi-source data and the depth camera are merged with the local map based on the Bayes rule. Experiments show that the global map obtained by this method contains richer environmental information than a single sensor, which improves the accuracy of map construction and is beneficial to subsequent navigation obstacle avoidance research.

articleTitle: Application research of data mining technology in customer relationship management
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Informatization is an important symbol of the Internet era. The management of customer information is a crucial event for enterprises. The maintenance of old customers and the absorption of new customers are important factors for enterprises to make profits. The traditional way of information processing is no longer suitable for the development of the current era. At present, it is the general trend to use the new way of information processing, namely customer relationship management system, to manage customer information. However, in the face of complex data, how to deal with it so as to find the knowledge and information we need from the data becomes extremely difficult. For this problem, the presentation of data mining technology gives a very meaningful answer. The data mining makes the role of CRM （Customer relationship management） system get a good play, so that customer information management in the global has been fully developed. This paper mainly discusses the application and research of data mining technology in CRM （ Customer relationship management）.

articleTitle: Improved SEIR model based on asymptomatic infection of COVID-19
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: With the rapid spread of COVID-19 worldwide, studying its transmission mechanism and exploring scientific control policies become important global issues. In this paper, SEIR epidemic model was improved by taking the asymptomatic infection into account and was used to simulate the spread of the epidemic in Hubei Province. Using the model to simulate and analyze the spread of the epidemic is helpful to provide references for the formulation of epidemic control policies at different stages.

articleTitle: Single-step model predictive control of VSC converter station supplying power to passive network
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: The AC power quality of the VSC converter station that supplies power to the passive network is in most cases affected by the PI control parameters. In this paper, the model predictive control algorithm without the need to modulate the PI parameters is applied to the VSC converter station control. Firstly, the discrete mathematical model of VSC inverter in αβ coordinate is derived, and the one-step prediction model of AC control voltage is established. Then, the corresponding cost function is constructed to obtain the next time optimal switching state to act on the inverter with the minimum cost function. Finally, a VSC inverter model that supplies power to the passive network is established in MATLAB, and a single-step model predictive control strategy is used to do simulation studies on the conditions of linear load, sudden load change, AC voltage reference value change, and model parameter deviation. The results show that the single-step model predictive control method adopted in this paper improves the power quality and the robustness of the control system.

articleTitle: Traction Network Resonance Suppression Strategy Based on Auxiliary Filter Winding of Traction Transformer
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: This paper analyzes the harmonic transmission characteristics of the traction network and the characteristics of the resonance of the traction network through a simplified traction network model, and gives a traction network resonance suppression measure based on the auxiliary filter winding of the train traction transformer. Compared with traditional methods, this method is simpler to implement, lower in cost, and has a good compensation effect. Finally, by building a train-traction network joint simulation model, the correctness of the parameter design of the proposed resonance suppression method and the superiority of the resonance suppression effect are verified.

articleTitle: An EMG Gesture Recognition Method based on Multivariate Variational Mode Decomposition
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Surface electromyography(sEMG) can reflect the state of muscle activity which has important application value in human-computer interaction, prosthetic control and clinical diagnosis. In this paper, a gesture recognition method based on convolutional neural network(CNN) as well as multivariate variational mode decomposition(MVMD) is proposed. Firstly, the MVMD is used to decompose the EMG signals into several levels to extract the spatiotemporal characteristics of the multi-channel EMG signals, and then the convolutional neural network(CNN) is trained by the spatiotemporal characteristics. As experimental results show, compared with the simply EMG images, the performance of the proposed model is improved by 16.77%, 18.70% and 13.60% respectively. Compared with multivariate empirical mode decomposition(MEMD), MVMD uses less components, which can significantly reduce the training cost of neural network.

articleTitle: Thermodynamic Study on the Formation of Lanthanum Inclusions in 20MnSi Steel
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)

articleTitle: Evaluation of Urban Crime Risk Based on Agent Simulation Model
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Computer simulation methods are comprehensively applied to engineering research. After literature research and basic experiments, more and more disciplines apply this method. Based on the flexibility and applicability of personally-made models combined with behavioral framework, simulation method may be very suitable for crime research. According to the urban layout and crime characteristics, the ABM model and simulation technology are used to study the evolution of urban crime risks, and simulation experiments are carried out to provide suggestions for crime risk assessment and early warning. The simulation results finally show that the simulation results can provide early warning of urban crime risks and improve the actual police work. Finally, this paper fully proves that the method of simulation can be used to understand crime and improve the process of crime management, and to formulate effective crime prevention strategies.

articleTitle: Segmentation of Hippocampus based on 3DUnet-CBAM Model
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: The assessment of the hippocampus is indispensable for the supplementary diagnosis of Alzheimer's disease. In response to the small size of the hippocampus and the difficulty of accurate segmentation, this paper proposes a 3DUnet-CBAM based hippocampal segmentation model. A 3DUnet convolutional network is used to avoid information loss between two-dimensional slices, and a CBAM attention mechanism is incorporated in the last layer of downsampling. The deep and superficial features of the hippocampus are effectively combined. The segmentation accuracy of the hippocampus is finally improved. Experimental results show that the model achieves 89.01%, 89.04% and 88.97% for dice, precision and recall under the validation set, respectively, which can better assist doctors in diagnosing Alzheimer's disease.

articleTitle: The Application of UAV in Intelligent Distribution Line Acceptance System
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: This research realizes the automatic modeling function of graphics and basic ledger by using UAV to collect data of distribution line resources. The UAV is equipped with a lens front-end intelligent recognition chip to realize the edge computing function of the mobile sensing terminal. The realization of the coordinate collection of power distribution line towers, the identification of power distribution equipment could be achieved by the proposed system. With the completion of graphics and basic ledger automatic modeling and other functions, the system will finally support the regional synchronization and online development of the intelligent automatic acceptance of power distribution line drones.

articleTitle: Reliability improvement scheme of DDR controller based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: This article first discusses the DDR3 system calibration principle of the Virtex-7 series FPGA, analyzes the reliability of the DDR3 controller under different temperature and voltage conditions, and then proposes a solution to improve the reliability of the DDR3 controller. Simulation verification and on-board debugging test results show that this solution can effectively improve the reliability of the DDR3 system in FPGA devices under different temperature and voltage changes.

articleTitle: The Fault Analysis of Analog Circuit Based on BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: This article studies the fault analysis of analog circuit based on BP neural network. The fault characteristics are obtained by Monte Carlo analysis of analog circuit. The BP neural network is constructed by MATLAB and applied to the fault diagnosis of circuit. The results show that BP neural network can quickly locate the fault point in the continuous training optimization because of its self-learning ability, which has higher detection quality and efficiency. And the BP neural network has a strong application in large-scale circuit system.

articleTitle: Research on MPPT of Partial Shading Photovoltaic Array Based on BAS Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Under the condition of partial shading, the photovoltaic array's output presents multi-peak and nonlinear characteristics, which leads to the failure of the traditional MPPT control method. Based on the output characteristics of series photovoltaic cells under partial shading, this paper analyzes the reasons why the conventional MPPT algorithm falls into the local extremum and the oscillation of the output curve when steady. This paper proposes a new MPPT control method named Multi Constant Voltage Beetle Antennae Search (MVC-BAS), which combines the advantages of the multi constant voltage method and the Beetle Antennae Search algorithm. The MPPT control method based on boost circuit is verified in Matlab / Simulink platform and compared with the traditional MPPT control method. The simulation results show that the MCV-BAS algorithm has the advantages of few parameters needing, fast convergence, strong anti-interference, and avoiding falling into local extremum when dealing with complex shading conditions. This algorithm has advantages in tracking the maximum power point of the photovoltaic array under partial shading.

articleTitle: Analysis of Short Circuit Faults of Multiple Converters in Parallel of CRAFT Magnet Power Supply
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: The CRAFT magnet power system is an important part of the CRAFT project. It uses the phase-controlled rectification method of the thyristor to provide continuous and stable direct current to the superconducting coil, and then realizes the control of plasma generation, displacement, and deformation under different operating modes. In this paper, the simulation model of CRAFT magnet power supply system is built by MATLAB simulation software. Through this model, the waveform results of the DC side short-circuit fault state of the magnet power system are analyzed and the short-circuit current peak value and steady-state value of the fault are obtained. At the same time, the change of short-circuit current peak value and steady-state value under the short-circuit fault state when multiple converters are connected in parallel is innovatively proposed, which provides important reference value for the fault protection scheme of magnet power supply in the future.

Author Keywords: short-circuit analysis of multiple converters in parallel

articleTitle: AI Application: Real-time Tracking of a Small Number of Moving Objects by Camera
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Ordinary camera is usually fixed at a certain angle, so real-time target tracking is difficult to achieve. However, in practice, fixed-angle monitoring equipment cannot fully meet the needs of the field of security. In this paper, we proposed a monitoring system for tracking the single moving target in order to solve the above problems. The open machine vision (OpenMV) is used to achieve the image acquisition and recognition, and the dynamic targets are detected through a series of image processing algorithms. At the same time, the pan-tilt is used as the bearing tool of the camera, and then the pan-tilt is controlled through the Arduino (a Single-Chip Microcomputer) to ensure that the camera can track the target in real time and provide a better perspective to obtain more information. Experiment results are shown to prove the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed strategy.

Author Keywords: mobile perspective moving target recognition and tracking

articleTitle: Analysis and Research on Asset Collection and Information data processing of Power Grid Companies under the View of Holistic Assets
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: This paper systematically combs the basic classification characteristics of Asset Management of power grid companies, and constructs a new fixed asset management mode based on asset group. Combined with the company's business chain and value chain, the assets of The Power Grid Company are analyzed, the asset collection method and Information data processing of the value chain of its assets is determined, so as to realize the horizontal coordination of the whole business of the enterprise and cover the whole assets of the enterprise vertically.

articleTitle: High-precision 3D face normal map generation
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: In the current field of face reconstruction, the methods of face reconstruction tend to pay more attention to the optimization of the face model, and seldom study the surface details or even the skin realism, which leads to the greatly reduced realistic of the model and can not achieve good application effect. In this paper, we improve the quality of normal map to lay the foundation for the realistic face reconstruction. Based on the existing face reconstruction, the normal mapping of the object surface is reconstructed by image pre-processing and photometric stereo technology for face photos with the same angle and different illumination directions. This paper improves the photometric stereo algorithm to improve the efficiency and effect of normal mapping.

articleTitle: Research on Control Strategy of Power-on and Power-off for Pure Electric Vehicles Based on D2P Platform
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of long development cycle, poor reliability and stability, and vehicle safety of traditional electric vehicle control strategies, a set of pure electric vehicle power-on and power-off control strategies was designed based on the D2P rapid development platform and the V-shaped process development model. Using Matlab/Simulink modeled control strategy development environment, the connection between product-level VCU and control strategy was established through MotoHawk. The HIL test results show that the control strategy can quickly respond to the driver’s operation intention, can effectively guarantee the safety, stability and reliability of the vehicle control, and meet the design requirements.

Author Keywords: Power on and off control strategy

articleTitle: Reliability Evaluation of phase-mission Systems Based on discrete-time Bayesian network
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: For the general no-reparable phase-mission system, the working time of each phase is usually different. In this paper, the working time of each phase of the system is discretized to a fixed value, and the reliability probability of each time is obtained by using discrete-time Bayesian network. The discrete-time Bayesian network model of each phase is constructed respectively. The directed edges are used to deal with the phase dependence problems, and the Bayesian network model of the system is obtained. In this paper, the discrete-time Bayesian network is used to evaluate the general phase-mission system, and the feasibility of this method is verified by comparing with the universal generating function(UGF) and Monte Carlo(MC) method.

articleTitle: Research on UAV cooperative formation and path planning algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Unmanned ship technology is a derivative of the development of robotics, which has been gradually applied in maritime search and rescue, water quality monitoring and management, military reconnaissance and other fields. There are two core problems in the research of unmanned ship technology: cooperative formation and path planning, that is, how to keep the relative geometry and avoid obstacles in real time when the unmanned ship moves on the global optimal path. To solve the above problems, this paper proposes the base leader-follower method and the improved A* algorithm for the cooperative formation and global path planning of unmanned ships.

articleTitle: The Impact of Connector Degradation on Signal Transmission in Humid Environment
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Radio frequency connectors are widely used in microwave equipment and radio frequency circuits. Connector degradation in harsh environment may lead to the deterioration of signal integrity and communication quality. In this paper, the effects of connector dielectric degradation on signal transmission in humid environment were presented by the way of experimental tests and theoretical analysis. The equivalent dielectric constant of the degraded dielectric was calculated and a circuit model was developed to explain these effects. The simulation results of the circuit model were in good agreements with the measurement results. In addition, the impacts of dielectric degradation on digital signal waveform and eye diagram were predicted using the model. The results of this research provided a better understanding of the influence of connector dielectric degradation on signal transmission in humid environment.

articleTitle: Market Information Analysis and Strategy Research of Pumped Storage Power Stations to Promote Safe and Reliable Operation of Power System
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: With the proposal of China’s carbon neutral goal, the proportion of renewable energy power generation will be further expanded. Large-scale grid integration of renewable energy will bring huge challenges to power grid control and distribution technology. As an energy storage facility, pumped storage power station has the advantages of quickly responding to load changes and improving power quality, which can effectively improve the flexibility of the power system. This paper first analyzes the impact of power market reform on the investment and daily operation of pumped storage power station. Secondly, this paper conducts research on the relationship between the various entities in the power system related to the operation of pumped storage power stations in the market environment. Finally, the development strategy of promoting pumped storage development and ensuring the safe and reliable operation of power system is put forward through information element correlation analysis.

articleTitle: Talking about the key technology and development direction of underwater manipulator
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: The ocean in the 20th century is a hot and emerging research field. Whether it is fishing for marine fisheries, the exploration and development of marine resources, or the collection of underwater specimens in the direction of marine science, it needs to be carried out underwater. For now, the underwater manipulator or robotic arm is a kind of underwater operation tool we usually use. It relies on the underwater robot and cooperates with the underwater robot to complete a series of flexible actions to achieve underwater operations. purpose. Obviously, the underwater manipulator is the main part of the underwater robot, and most of the functions of the underwater robot are realized by the underwater manipulator. Due to its diversified functions, underwater manipulators also have a variety of design requirements. There are also key technologies such as motion control in the design process and some technologies are still stagnant. Based on the current situation, this article introduces the key technology and development direction of underwater manipulator research for reference.

articleTitle: A fast non-destructive defect detection method for complex PCB surfaces
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: In the manufacturing process of a ceramic resonant cavity with a PCB, different components of the PCB have different light reflectivity, which greatly reduce the defect detection accuracy. In this paper, a defect detection system with its defect detection algorithm for complex PCB surface is proposed, which is suitable for manufacturing workshop. Some images of good samples are selected in advance and are fused as the template image. Then the template image is divided into three parts due to the light reflectivity of different material bases. Through the template matching between the template image and the image to be detected, an affine transformation matrix is obtained. After matching, the difference between the template and the target image can greatly reduce the interference caused by the different light reflectivity of the material base, and improve the detection efficiency of cross-regional defects. The algorithm has been well applied in actual production. At present, the number of samples detected has exceeded 100,000, and the average detection speed is about 1s/piece. Using the result of manual inspection as standard, every actual defective sample is selected, and the precision rate of samples is 98.3%.

articleTitle: Zebra crossing segmentation based on depthwise separable convolutions
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: The research of zebra crossing recognition plays an extremely important role in vehicle detection and blind guidance system. From the experiment, we find a method of zebra crossing detection and recognition based on depthwise separable convolutions. In the coding part, we use depthwise separable convolutions to extract the layer from the trunk model, which has been convolved many times and has certain characteristics. In the decoding part, the PSPNet model is improved, the coding layers with different downsampling generations are used for comparison, and all the extraction layers are stacked to get the prediction results, thus solving the problem of small targets disappearing. Through experimental analysis and data training, the mean intersection over union of zebra crossing segmentation reaches 90.7%, and the average recognition speed is less than 0.1s.

articleTitle: Critical angle method applied in determining the refractive indices and axis direction of crystal
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Measurement of birefringence is crucial for the investigation of polarization optical components, including frequency-doubling crystal, electro-optic crystal, liquid crystal modulator. The commonly used measurement methods are based on determining the phase difference after transmission, and scarcely any method based on reflection is utilized. We propose an improved method of measuring the refractive index curve mode of anisotropy crystals during rotation, based on which we are able to determine the refractive indices and optical axis directions of the crystal according to a retrieval method. The measurement method involves precisely rotating and scanning the index ellipsoid and extracts two refractive indices from images captured at every rotation angle. The retrieval method processes two sets of data in a group and gives the fitted parameters, including the refractive indices and the optical axis direction in space. Simulation results are given, and two types of crystal, quartz and selenite, exemplifying uniaxial crystal and biaxial crystal, are experimented. The experiment results show that the fitted parameters are in good agreement with the theory. Compared with existing methods, our method has two main advantages. The sample does not need to be cut into a specific shape or prior information of the sample obtained, meanwhile the complete optical axis direction in space, including the intersection angle to the surface plane and the azimuth angle in the plan, can be determined, which benefits the evaluation and improvement of the material.

articleTitle: A Framework of SAT Solver Based on the ZYNQ
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Boolean Satisfiability (SAT) Problem is one of the key issues in the fields of both logic theory and computer applications. At present, the software and hardware based SAT solvers are both important in various applications. However, there still are many occasions that require the flexibility of software as well as the speed of hardware. It is valuable to develop a solver that combines software and hardware. Therefore, this paper proposed a framework of SAT solver on the ZYNQ platform, in which the assignments of variables are generated by a program in C-language and a concrete SAT problem is designed as an external device, two of them cooperates to solve the SAT problems. And a solving system was built based on the framework. The experimental results show that the framework of SAT solver is highly feasible and correct.

articleTitle: Multi-sensor Detection Alliance Based on Improved Plant Cell Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: In order to acquire better multi-sensor detection alliance schemes, an improved plant cell swarm algorithm is proposed. The algorithm is proposed based on the natural phenomenon that the whole plant has the maximum contact area with the sunlight due to the sunward nature of the plant in the growth process, which includes five steps: initialization of plant cell population, determination of the location of the strongest light, distribution of auxin, calculation of growth rate and update of plant cell population. The simulation part compares the improved plant cell swarm algorithm (IPCCA) with the basic plant cell swarm algorithm (BPCCA), particle swarm algorithm (PSOA), bee colony algorithm (BCOA) and wolf colony algorithm (WCOA) to verify the effectiveness of the improved plant cell swarm algorithm. The simulation results show that the improved plant cell swarm algorithm has the strongest optimization ability, can effectively avoid premature and jump out of the local optimal solution, and has good global search ability in dealing with multi-sensor detection alliance problem.

articleTitle: A Study of Passive Intermodulation of Analog Modulated Signals in Coaxial Connectors
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: In the communication systems, passive intermodulation (PIM) induced by the nonlinear effect of coaxial connectors may impact the transmission quality of analog modulated signals, when the analog modulated signals are transmitted through coaxial connectors. In this paper, based on the traditional polynomial model of PIM products, an empirical expression of PIM products in coaxial connectors was deduced from a series of PIM two-tone tests, curve fitting and coefficient extraction. For different signal modulated modes, the simulation results of PIM characteristics of analog modulated signals in coaxial connectors were respectively obtained using the empirical expression applied to ADS simulator. In addition, the Adjacent Channel Power Ratio (ACPR) metric was introduced to quantify the effect of PIM interference in the modulated signal frequency band, providing a theoretical basis for evaluating the performance of analog modulated signals in coaxial connectors against PIM interference.

articleTitle: Prediction for the α-decay chains of 307-318126 isotopes
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: We systematically evaluated the α-decay and spontaneous fission (SF) for <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">308-318</sup>216 isotopes. The α-decay half-lives were calculated by the Parkhomenko formula, The Brown formula and Universal Decay Law (UDL) formula. The results of the three formulas are basically the same. The SF half-lives of those nuclei were obtained by the Xu formula, which is reasonable for describing the SF half-lives of the superheavy nuclei. The competition of the α-decay and the SF half-lives can help us to understand the dominate decay modes of the isotope. The decay modes of unknown nuclei <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">308-318</sup>216 are predicted.

articleTitle: Analysis of TCM gynecology prescriptions based on Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Logistic regression and cluster analysis were used to compare the influence of age on the selection of traditional Chinese medicine.The results showed that there were 8 kinds of traditional Chinese medicine which had no significant effect on the frequency of use with the increase of age, and they were divided into 2 groups by cluster analysis; there were 8 kinds of traditional Chinese medicine whose frequency of use increased significantly with the increase of age, and they were divided into 2 groups; there were 12 kinds of traditional Chinese medicine whose frequency of use decreased significantly with the increase of age, and they were divided into 3 groups.A conclusion can be drew that young women are full of healthy qi and strong constitution. Their diseases are mainly caused by excess and evil. The treatment principle of drugs is to dredge, dissipate, clear away heat and detoxify. For middle-aged women, deficiency of liver and kidney and deficiency of vital energy are the main treatment principles.

articleTitle: An improved FastSLAM algorithm based on stream computing
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) is a key problem for mobile robots to realize autonomous exploration. SLAM is a typical computing intensive task, and has high computing requirements for mobile robots. To improve the efficiency and accuracy for SLAM process, a high real-time computing mode based on stream computing is built in the cloud edge. In this mode, the distributed parallel SLAM is carried out. Based on 5G communication, Kafka component is used for message transmission between the cloud edge and mobile robot. In the cloud edge, the SLAM process is divided into four steps, data reading, particle updating, particle sampling and result pushing. Comparing the traditional FastSLAM algorithm, the proposed algorithm has the better estimation quality and shorter execution time. Experiments verify the feasibility and effectiveness of this algorithm.

articleTitle: Brain image conversion method based on generative adversarial network
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: In recent years, brain image conversion technology has become popular in the field of medical imaging, and plays a very important auxiliary role in clinical diagnosis and disease detection of brain diseases, such as brain image reconstruction, brain image noise reduction and brain image segmentation. The brain image conversion technology aims to learn the mapping relationship between two different modal brain images, and can convert one modal brain image into another modal brain image. However, there are complex relationships between different modal data, and there is no unified theoretical framework to realize the conversion between different modal data. Therefore, we propose a brain image conversion method based on generative adversarial network to realize the conversion between different modal brain images, and prove the superiority of this method through experiments.

articleTitle: FPGA based timing calibration scheme for embedded EFUSE
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: This paper first introduces the influence of process parameter fluctuation on FPGA interconnect timing. Then, according to the characteristics of FPGA architecture and the implementation method, the reason of FPGA chip yield reduction caused by interconnect timing difference is analyzed. Finally, this paper proposes a technical scheme of embedded EFUSE timing calibration, and introduces the calibration circuit. Chip test results show that the scheme can effectively control interconnect timing deviation and improve FPGA chip yield when process fluctuation is serious.

articleTitle: Research on the Z-axis Magnetic Sensor Based on the Giant Magnetoresistance Effect
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Magnetoresistive sensors are usually used to measure the magnetic field with the direction parallel to the plane of the magnetic sensor, but a soft magnetic permalloy flux concentrator is integrated in the sensor, and can change the direction of the magnetic field in the magnetic sensor, so that the magnetoresistive unit can also measure the magnetic field (the Z axis) perpendicular to the plane of the magnetic sensor. The magnetic concentrator is usually made of permalloy with high magnetic permeability. The flux concentrator is designed into a grid structure, the magnetic field (the Z axis) perpendicular to the sensing plane of the sensor can generate the magnetic field component in the sensor plane (the XY axis), and the giant magnetoresistance (GMR) magneto-sensitive unit located under the magnetic concentrator can measure the Z-axis magnetic field. The GMR magneto-sensitive unit is composed of four bridge arms, which are connected by metal conductive materials to form a Wheatstone bridge structure. The two magneto-sensitive units on the opposite bridge arms of the bridge are located on both sides of the soft magnetic grid respectively and form the push-pull structure under the action of the magnetic field, so that the strength of the output signal of the sensor is doubled, and the vertical packaging form of the conventional Z-axis sensor is also prevented. According to the experimental results, the sensitivity of the Z-axis giant magnetoresistance sensor with this structure can reach 0.8 mV/Oe, and the magnetic field measurement range can reach 150 Oe. It can be used in various fields such as geomagnetic measurement and current measurement.

articleTitle: CRAFT TF Magnet Power Supply Overcurrent Protection Design
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: The overcurrent due to the short circuit of the thyristor arm is considered to be one of the important research contents. In the Comprehensive Research Facility for Fusion Technology (CRAFT) power supply system, when a short circuit occurs in the converter arm, the general protection method is to use a fuse for protection, but the way to select fuse is very blind, and the matching and suitability are not very good, resulting in a waste of components. In this paper, theoretical calculation and simulation verification are used for the CRAFT TF magnet power system, based on the principle of reliable fuse when the converter arm is short-circuited, and the principle of no action when the reactor is short-circuited, the fault current of the fast fuse is verified to determine the fast. The fuse model and the simulation results show that the selected fast fuse can effectively suppress the overcurrent, and the CRAFT tf magnet power system has been effectively protected.

articleTitle: Study of Design Means to Discourage Errors Resulting from Flight Crew Operating Landing Gear Control Lever
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Firstly, this paper describes the background and the purpose about study of design means to discourage errors resulting from flight crew operating the landing gear control lever for civil aircraft. Secondly, it lists the design criteria about discouraging flight crew errors. Thirdly, it analyzes the effect of errors resulting from flight crew operating the landing gear control lever on aircraft and determines the applicable criteria. Thirdly, based on the criteria determined above, it proposes some design means to discourage errors resulting from flight crew operating the landing gear control lever. Lastly, it draws the conclusion that the design criteria, the analysis process and the proposed design means mentioned in this paper are expected to be used as a reference to design means to discourage errors resulting from flight crew operating the landing gear control lever and other cockpit controls for civil aircraft.

articleTitle: PCA-based Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation Method for Pipeline Risk Assessment
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Scientific risk assessment of submarine oil and gas pipeline can prevent pipeline leakage accidents. In this paper, the main control factors and their weights extracted from the principal component analysis (PCA) are adopted as the weight matrix of the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation (FCE). Compared with the traditional FCE, the PCA-based FCE proposed in this paper not only eliminates the redundant indexes in the pipeline risk evaluation index set, but avoids the subjectivity of the index weight determination. The proposed method is applied to the risk assessment of a section of submarine pipeline, and the simulation result shows the effectiveness.

articleTitle: Analysis of distribution characteristics of underwater optical soliton received beam
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: In order to obtain the receiving beam with more concentrated energy distribution, Monte Carlo method was used to study the receiving beam distribution characteristics of optical solitons as light sources. According to the characteristics of the optical soliton pulse, the expression of the initial sampling radius of the optical soliton is deduced, and the beam expansion characteristics and optical power density of the two soliton and Gaussian pulse light sources are simulated and analyzed. The results show that the optical soliton's receiving beam has a higher power density than the Gaussian pulsed beam, and it performs better in underwater anti-scattering, which provides theoretical support for the design of underwater receivers and underwater positioning.

articleTitle: Research on UWB positioning trajectory prediction based on LSTM
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of the neural network in predicting and positioning based on Ultra-Wideband (UWB), a method based on long and short-term memory network to predict UWB positioning data is proposed, which is comparable to ordinary neural networks that only use current information for training. Compared with the method based on long and short-term memory network prediction, the historical information is effectively used. First, the UWB bilateral two-way ranging algorithm is used to obtain the ranging value as the feature information, the Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) model is established, and the optimal coordinates obtained by the least square method are used as the output supervision training. Finally, combined with the historical data of UWB positioning trajectory to predict the current coordinates of the test set graphics, it is verified that the method in this paper greatly improves the positioning accuracy of UWB compared with ordinary neural network prediction positioning.

articleTitle: Research on Input-Output Index System Construction of The Power Grid Company Asset Value
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: On the basis of asset classification of asset group, the specific category of asset input-output value collection of asset group of the Power Grid Company is determined. This paper systematically combs the company's intangible assets value evaluation method, intangible assets method and intangible assets classification. Starting from three aspects of security, reliability and economy of power grid operation, as well as the asset status and DEA method provided by various management departments of power grid, the input-output evaluation index system of asset group of The Power Grid Company is constructed.

Author Keywords: Power grid company group assets value assessment

articleTitle: Application of velocity plus fixed axial angular velocity match method in transfer alignment of SINS based on the moving base
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: A new transfer alignment method of strapdown inertial navigation system (SINS) on moving base based on combination parameter matching methods is introduced to solve the problems of transfer alignment accuracy which is decreased by the inaccurate dynamic modeling and the hull which is buckled by wind waves and other factors. Firstly,the system state model of attitude error, velocity error and dynamic deflection of SINS was constructed. Secondly,the matching measurement equation of velocity plus fixed axial angular velocity is derived. Finally,the method is simulated and verified in three cases under the mooring condition. The simulation results show that the transfer alignment method with velocity plus arbitrary axial angular velocity matching can estimate the misalignment angle and the deflection angle. The estimation accuracy of horizontal misalignment angle, azimuth misalignment angle, and deflection angle are 2′, 6′ and 2′, respectively. The calculation amount is also obviously reduced.

articleTitle: Path Planning and Model Design for Internet Plus Technology Innovation and Entrepreneurship Training
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Technological development and industrial upgrading need innovation, and Internet plus technology provides the carrier for entrepreneurship. Talent is still the key factor, and the improvement of innovation and entrepreneurship ability needs the help of internal and external forces and multiple resources. The paper proposes the training model of Internet plus technology innovation and entrepreneurship, which includes multiple space time, multiple carrier and multilevel collaboration, and the countermeasures to incorporate everything. Internet plus technology innovation and entrepreneurship training needs to integrate resources, manpower, material resources, technology, and other factors. Based on the introduction of Internet plus technology, we should establish platform, curriculum resources, teamwork and other collaborative promotion, and switch offline and online flexibly, push on demand and system learning in parallel, promote each other through theory and practice, form innovative and entrepreneurial talents training and personalized talent training, and create new talents. Integrated innovative personnel training mechanism. The innovation of this paper is to put forward the training of integrating innovation and entrepreneurship in various forms, levels and directions, integrating Internet plus technology and platform, carrying out creative design, innovation training, entrepreneurship support, specialized integration and integration of government, school and enterprise resources, and establishing a normal operation mechanism. Finally, practice scheme, approach and path are proposed to form an complete system framework to cultivate creative and entrepreneur talents.

articleTitle: Research on the Strategy of Automatic Needle Knitting Based on Machine Vision and Cross-stitch Embroidery
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: With the development of cross stitch market demand, machine cross stitch instead of manual cross stitch has become an inevitable trend in the development of cross stitch industry. This paper studies a fully automatic stitch knitting method based on machine vision technology and cross stitch spectrum extraction, in order to improve the automation and intelligence level of cross stitch industry and improve the quality of embroidery products.

articleTitle: Protocol design and implementation of VLC/OCC heterogeneous network
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Nowadays, VLC/RF heterogeneous network has been widely studied, but the network is not working properly under the scenario of restricted RF technology (underwater communication and mine communication, strong magnetic environment such as high voltage distribution room, hospital radiology department, etc.). This paper studies the visible light communication (VLC)/ optical camera communication (OCC) heterogeneous network which can be applied under the scenario of restricted RF technology. We design the frame format, access protocol, communication protocol and build the experimental platform. The experiments show that the heterogeneous network designed in this paper can achieve reliable VLC communication at 1Mbps within 4.6m and reliable OCC communication at 240Kbps.

articleTitle: A Study of Passive Intermodulation of RF Connectors in Vibration Environment
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: RF connectors generally have slight nonlinear characteristics. The nonlinearity of connectors can cause passive intermodulation (PIM) interference. The RF connectors will degrade due to the vibration environment, which will aggravate the PIM interference and affect the transmission quality of communication systems. In this paper, a vibration device is designed for a series of accelerated degradation tests of N-type RF connectors. The contact stress is selected as the index to quantify the degradation degree of the connectors. The main findings of the test are that passive intermodulation is greatly affected by vibration contact pressure. The parameters of the theoretical model are modified through the test results of a series of vibration comparative experiments, and a developed high-order power series model is proposed to obtain a higher accuracy prediction of harmonic power.

articleTitle: Research on Location Selection of Charging Stations under the Condition of Urban Facilities in Cold Regions
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: This paper analyzes the facilities in cold areas to determine the factors that affect the location of charging stations. According to the operating characteristics of pure electric vehicles in cold areas and the service coverage of charging stations, a service model for charging stations based on the shortest possible mileage of remaining power is constructed. With the charging station service model based on the shortest mileage of the remaining power, and the greedy algorithm is used to solve the problem to determine the location of the charging station. Finally, based on the data related to the operation of pure electric vehicles in Urumqi and the service coverage radius of the charging station, the charging station in Urumqi was deployed.

articleTitle: Some Thoughts on Cloud Service Management of University Library
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Against the backdrop of the development of Internet informatization, big data technology, cloud computing technology and so on began to be widely used in various fields. University libraries, as a digital resource sharing platform, also apply cloud computing service technology to the development and construction of network libraries to realize the docking between digital book resources and diversified user services. Based on the main features and technical content of cloud computing services, this paper analyzes the cloud service construction of university library management, and sets up a multi-hierarchical library cloud service management system as well as user desktop cloud control and management structure, so as to meet the diverse demand of book data and information service of teachers and students on campus and subjects off campus.

articleTitle: Reliability Modeling and Verification of Communication Algorithm Flow for Intelligent Control System
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: The intelligent system controls the subsystems of each aircraft in real time to ensure the normal development of the tasks of the aircraft system. In the process of system communication, the control system is required to strictly control the correctness of the control algorithm flow and the accuracy of the control sequence in order to ensure the safety of the aircraft system. This paper uses UPPAAL, a formal model detection tool based on time automata theory, to formally model and validate the algorithm flow of an intelligent system and a subsystem. First, the algorithm flow of the intelligent system is analyzed, and then it is formally modeled using the time automaton method. Second, the properties that need to be verified are extracted from the algorithm flow and described with the formal language BNF. Finally, the function and performance correctness are automatically verified using the UPPAAL model detection tool. The experimental results verify that the intelligent system meets the security, accessibility and activity requirements.

articleTitle: Design of cloud learning work order system for software workshop application
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: In the exploration and practice of talent training mode of craftsman workshop, management is an important part, and supervising and checking the learning progress and knowledge mastery of students is an important part of management; in the cloud era of rapid development of information technology, applying cloud computing to the management of craftsman workshop is not only the embodiment of keeping pace with the times, but also a very effective and efficient management means. Based on this, this paper designs a cloud learning work order system for craftsman workshop management, and then implements it.

articleTitle: Study on the polarization of Yang's interference with finite sampling aperture
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Using the principle of Yang's interference, the transmission of the double mold beam in free space is studied and the expression of spectral polarization is obtained. This paper mainly discusses the influence of the size of finite aperture on Yang's interference stripes. Numerical calculations indicate that the polarization of the off-axis point changes more than the polarization of the point on the axis, and that the polarization will tend to the conclusion of the same value for different off-axis points when the transmission distance is far enough.

articleTitle: Dual genetic neural network method for robust optimization of square box forming
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: To solve the problems of high computational cost and difficulty in obtaining satisfactory coordinated solution in sheet metal deep drawing robust design, a dual genetic algorithm back propagation (Dual-GABP) neural network for multi-objective robust design is proposed by combining Kreisselmeier-Steinhauser (KS) function and GABP neural network. Firstly, the first GABP response surface model of sheet metal deep drawing is established by using experimental design samples and finite element simulation. Secondly, the second GABP model of the mean and standard deviation of sheet metal forming quality is constructed using the first GABP model and Monte Carlo simulation, and the computational cost can be reduced by replacing the finite element model with the first GABP model. Finally, the multi-objective optimization problem is transformed into a single-objective problem using the KS function, and the satisfactory coordinated solution is obtained by optimization. The multi-objective robust optimization of NUMISHEET’93 square box drawing is carried out by using the proposed process. Compared with the deterministic optimization results, the standard deviation of the thinning and the wrinkling index of the robust design are reduced by 41.5% and 18.1% respectively, and the robustness of forming quality is enhanced significantly.

articleTitle: Fault outage risk index evaluation of distribution network based on data-driven
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: In recent years, with the growing scale of the distribution network, the network structure is increasingly complex and the uncertainty is slowly increasing. Natural disasters, equipment failures, urban construction, man-made damage and other problems are easy to lead to serious consequences. Therefore, more and more attention has been paid to the risk of distribution network, and it is urgent to carry out targeted risk assessment on distribution network, prevent the occurrence of accidents in advance, reduce the harm of failure, and reduce the loss of failure. By collecting and analyzing data based on the power distribution network risk evaluation, and then using the neural network method to establish a distribution network risk assessment model based on sensitivity, through the analysis of the distribution network operation data, reasonable division of the target distribution network risk level, the number of correlation reveals the distribution network running state index and its transformation rule and connect with each other.

articleTitle: Application of Improved Genetic Algorithm PID Foreign Body Removal In Laser Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Because of its excellent characteristics, the laser has been applied to the field of foreign body removal in the power grid, and has great potential for development. To remove the foreign bodies efficiently, the control system of the laser’s two- dimensional turntable should be studied. By combining the improved genetic algorithm with PID control, the selection of mutation probability and crossover probability is improved. The results of MATLAB simulation show that the improved genetic algorithm PID zero overshoot, short time lag, and fast response speed when the unit step signal and interference signal are input simultaneously PID, compared with the traditional genetic algorithm PID and the traditional PID, the anti-jamming property is stronger and the system robustness is better. From the optimization curve of an objective function, it can be seen that the convergence speed PID of the improved genetic algorithm is much faster than that of the traditional genetic algorithm PID.

articleTitle: Automatic combination strategy search in segmentation of Cardiac T1 mapping image
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Fusion of multiple medical images may improve image quality and ease feature extraction for the diagnosis and therapy of diseases. In cardiac magnetic resonance (MR) images T1 mapping, multiple MR images are reconstructed for the estimation of T1 mapping; therefore, heart myocardium should be segmented from images for further analysis using T1 values. Traditionally, segmentation is performed for each image separately, and the per-image segmentation results are combined in a complicated way to get a final segmentation result. Traditional combination methods require the segmentation results of all images satisfy certain criteria, and therefore often fail because of low image quality. However, it is very difficult to design a combination strategy to integrate the information of multiple images for segmentation. In this study, we designed the Segfuse network based on convolutional neural networks to get strategies for improving the segmentation performance of T1 mapping images even when some images were of low quality. After validating with 112 images from 42 subjects, the segmentation accuracy based on the Segfuse had a mean dice of 80.2%, nearly equivalent to that of a traditional method.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Intelligent Layout System for Automobile Welding Jig
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Based on the study of two-dimensional irregular parts layout algorithm, a layout system suitable for semi-finished parts of automobile welding jig was designed and developed with visual studio as the development platform, using C++ language and CAA technology. This paper puts forward the system framework, the functions of the sub-modules and the interactive interface in detail. The system can effectively improve Jig manufacturing efficiency.

articleTitle: Cardiovascular Disease Prediction Model Based on Logistic Regression and Euclidean Distance
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Cardiovascular disease is the number one killer threatening human life and health. Globally, about 40% of deaths are caused by cardiovascular disease. This paper builds a model based on logistic regression method and similarity evaluation based on distance formula to predict cardiovascular disease. The data in this article comes from the kaggle platform. In the experiment, we used the logistic regression algorithm to build the first-stage model. The accuracy and recall rate of the model reached 88.5% and 89.2%. Then using the similarity evaluation method based on Euclidean distance, we optimize the data that cannot be processed in the first stage. Finally, a complete classification model is obtained. Finally, we bring the test data into the complete model. The recall rate of the model finally reached 98%, and the prediction accuracy rate also reached 98%.

articleTitle: An Interleaved Model for Chinese Socio-Economic Indicator Extraction
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Automatically extracting socio-economic indicators from text allows us to know the real status of a country or a company.
