Most conventional methods rely on hand-crafted features or use pipeline or joint deep learning model. They are either effort intensive or do not utilize the dependency between indicator detection and element extraction. In this paper, we use an interleaved model to cope with the challenges in this task. After feature extraction, the input sequence is first fed into the preliminary detection module to test whether it mentions indicators. If the sequence contains indicator mentions, it will then be input into element extraction module to extract indicator elements. If there are no elements, the sequence will be judged containing no indicators. We conduct extensive experiments on the dataset we build, which shows that the proposed model performs better both on f1-score and efficiency.

articleTitle: The Application of BP Neural Network Algorithm to Risk Evaluation of High-Tech Entrepreneurial Projects
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Back propagation (BP) neural network is characterized by the advantages of large-scale parallel, distributed processing, self-organization, and self-learning. It is suitable for handling problems that need to consider multiple conditions and fuzzy information simultaneously. Firstly, this paper expounds on the construction and algorithm of the BP neural network. Then, the risk index system of high-tech entrepreneurial projects was designed, and the evaluation levels and scoring method for the risk factor indicators were determined. Finally, we developed a model for risk evaluation of high-tech entrepreneurial projects based on the BP neural network. The empirical results show that the BP neural network has strong feasibility and effectiveness, and can accurately fit the training values to derive accurate prediction results. This method provides a new approach for risk evaluation of entrepreneurial projects.

articleTitle: Analysis of Stock Market Volatility Based on Python
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: As an open source programming language, python has been widely used in the field of data analysis and machine learning in recent years, especially in the financial field. It can solve almost all financial and economic measurement problems. Based on the daily closing price of CSI 300 index, this paper selects the data from January 5, 2005 to December 31, 2020, and takes the listing and restriction of stock index futures as the dividing point, uses the modules of pandas and arch in python language, adopts statistics method and GARCH model to study and analyze the impact of stock index futures on stock market volatility.

articleTitle: Research and Analysis of Indoor Positioning Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: With the advent of the era of the Internet of everything, The Internet of things industry has entered a new stage. With the support of the Internet, many emerging technology industries have been developed, such as smart home, unmanned driving, drones and other technologies. The attention of personnel, these technologies are more or less inseparable from positioning technology. Since GPS and Beidou positioning technology have been applied in our lives, many technologies have been greatly developed, such as navigation systems, which can greatly help people travel. However, the development of the city has promoted the establishment of many indoor venues. In the complex indoor environment, the GPS positioning signal is greatly attenuated due to the occlusion of the roof of the building, making the software unable to perform normal indoor applications. Due to the development of indoor positioning and its broad application prospects, indoor positioning has begun to be applied in many fields such as mobile phone mutual transmission, exhibition traffic statistics system, nursing home or hospital remote care system. This article summarizes and compares various software and hardware systems of indoor positioning technology to compare the pros and cons of various implementation methods.

articleTitle: Improvement of DPoS Consensus Mechanism in Collaborative Governance of Network Public Opinion
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: In the face of increasingly complex social public opinion situations, the traditional network public opinion governance models have increasingly prominent issues such as information transmission efficiency and information security. In order to establish a new model of fair, credible, and community co-management of network public opinion governance, this article uses blockchain as a key technology for collaborative governance of network public opinion. In order to meet the requirements of network governance, the Delegated Proof-of-Stake(DPoS) algorithm is improved to solve problems. After proposing a reputation model that considers time dynamic factors, this paper constructs a reputation-based voting mechanism and rewards and punishments incentive mechanism, and also designs a new method of counting votes. From the experiment results, it was found that the node participation has increased significantly, the proportion of error nodes was obviously reduced, and the operating efficiency was improved. It shows that the improved consensus algorithm can not only improve the security of the system, reduce the possibility of false public opinion spreading, but also improve the efficiency of information processing, so it can be well applied to information sharing and public opinion governance scenarios.

articleTitle: Performance Optimization Method of Wireless Power Transfer System Based on Magnetic Field Editing
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: In order to improve the adaptability of the magnetically coupled resonant wireless power transfer system to the changes in the position of the receiving coil, this paper first proposes a power transmitting coil array composed of five independent coils. By controlling the input voltage of the five independent coils, the magnetic field excited by the transmitting coil array can be edited. Then, the multi-input single-output wireless power transfer system composed of the proposed transmitting coil array and a single receiving coil is modeled and analyzed, and the calculation equations of the transmission efficiency and output power are obtained, and the multi-objective genetic algorithm is used to obtain the optimal solution for the input voltage of the transmitting coil array. Finally, the simulation analysis is carried out to verify the theoretical method. The results show that the proposed method can significantly enhance the adaptability of the wireless power transfer system to the lateral displacement and angle changes of the receiving coil, so that the wireless power transfer system can obtain stable transmission efficiency and output power.

articleTitle: Hybrid Pruning for Convolutional Neural Network Convolution Kernel
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: In the model compression, to achieve the optimal pruning effect, weighted pruning or filter pruning was used to prune the network in traditional methods, in fact, the network can continue to be compressed. Therefore, a hybrid pruning method of convolution kernel weight pruning and filter pruning are proposed in this paper. First of all, the weight pruning is carried out for the convolutional neural network model, this paper adopts the method of dynamic convolution kernel for weight pruning, and the fluctuation value of each time normalized value in network update process is taken as the pruning criterion for the weight of the convolutional kernel. Because the weight pruning of the convolution kernel is dynamic, the floating-point operation (FLOP) is significantly reduced, and the parameter scale does not decrease significantly. Then, the model was pruning by convolution kernel ℓ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf>-norm [1] method, which is not only effectively reduce the parameter scale, but also no extra calculations are introduced. In the case of a small loss of network accuracy, the hybrid pruning of the convolution kernel can maximize the compression of the model to meet the conditions for deployment in mobile edge devices, and has significant improvements in floating-point operations and parameter compression. Therefore, mixed pruning in this paper can effectively make up for the shortage of single pruning method. Through VGG-16, ResNet and other networks, it has been proved in practice that the convolution kernel hybrid pruning method proposed in this paper can effectively reduce the model size and maintain a high level of accuracy.

Index Terms: Least Absolute Shrinkage And Selection Operator

articleTitle: A Light-weight Ship Detection and Recognition Method Based on YOLOv4
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Ship detection and recognition based on deep learning often needs high standard hardware support while achieving high precision, which is difficult to adapt to offshore resource-limited platforms. Trying to solve this problem, this paper adopts the one-step target detection model YOLOv4 as the framework and applies a comprehensive network simplifying method. Firstly, this method applies different lightweight backbone networks in the framework to obtain the ideal Mobilenetv2-YOLOv4 network, and then conducts sparse training based on the scale factor of the batch normalization layer. Finally, it selects an appropriate threshold to prune unessential channel, which obtains a light-weight ship detection neural network for ship detection and recognition. The average accuracy of the network for detecting and identifying targets of 8 types of ships reaches 92.8% on average, the real-time detection speed is 37 frames per second, and the detection efficiency is 70% higher than that of the original network, which is capable of real-time detection under the condition of limited resources. The results also show that under simple tasks, appropriate methods can effectively compress the network parameters and computations while maintaining accuracy.

articleTitle: Architecture Design and Application of distributed power trading System based on blockchain Asynchronous Consensus
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: With the deepening of electric power system reformation and the enhancement of distributed energy permeability, distributed energy in power generation and sales side of effective configuration is facing opportunities and challenges. The traditional centralized power trading mode is centralized trading, which has many problems such as low transparency, high cost, low efficiency and unreliable data, so it’s unable to adapt to the large-scale distributed power trading scenario. In this context, this paper proposes a distributed power trading mechanism based on blockchain asynchronous consensus mechanism, analyzes the compatibility between blockchain technology and distributed power trading mode, carries out research on the asynchronous consensus mechanism, designs the blockchain-based distributed power trading system architecture and process method and carries out trial application to improve the consensus efficiency of the system consensus. Meanwhile, the mechanism could solve the trust problem in the process of distributed power trading, and ensure the transparency and fairness of distributed power trading.

articleTitle: Optimal Scheduling of CCHP Based on Comprehensive Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: In the case of excessive consumption of fossil energy and increasingly serious environmental pollution, the use of renewable energy power generation and gas turbine units to build a multi energy complementary integrated energy system, improve energy efficiency and reduce environmental pollution is the current hot issue. In this paper, the output of wind and solar renewable energy is combined with the Combined cooling, heating and power (CCHP) system of gas turbine. Considering the temperature comfort and power load demand response, a CCHP system based on comprehensive demand response is proposed. The scenario generation method is used to consider the uncertainty of renewable energy output, and the optimal scheduling model is established. The simulation results show that the model can effectively reduce the comprehensive operation cost and has significant economic and social value.

articleTitle: Baby Search Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a novel meta-heuristic algorithm, called Baby Search Algorithm (BSA), for solving complex optimization problems. BSA mimics the behavior of babies who have strong curiosity about external things and can actively look for things of interest. Generally speaking, babies' search behaviors are divided into two types, one is to find another interesting thing, which is similar to exploration in the optimization problem; the other is to approach the most interesting thing at present, which is similar to exploitation. In order to balance exploration and exploitation, we utilize two probability thresholds to control it. In addition, we further combine Levy flight and mutation operations in BSA, which can make the babies' search get closer to the nature of searching behavior. We validate the proposed algorithm against test functions and then compare its performance with those of twelve state-of-the-art algorithms. Finally, we discuss the implication of the results and suggestion for further research.

articleTitle: The multi-innovation adaptive extended Kalman filter algorithm for battery SOC estimation
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of low accuracy of online estimation of lithium battery under unknown noise, an adaptive extended Kalman filter algorithm combined with the theory of multi-innovation was proposed. On this basis, in order to verify the validity of the algorithm, firstly established for MI - AEKF second order battery model to estimate the SOC(state of charge) by using the parameter identification method of offline recognition model of relevant parameters and model precision. Secondly, experiments are designed to compare the estimation accuracy of multi-innovation extended Kalman filter method with traditional EKF and AEKF methods, so as to realize the accuracy verification of MI-AEKF method.The experimental results show that the error of the MI-AEKF method in estimating SOC under unknown noise is less than 1.8%, while EKF and AEKF fluctuate between 2% and 3%. Compared with EKF and AEKF, the MI-AEKF method has the advantages of fast convergence speed and high estimation accuracy.

articleTitle: An improved track association algorithm based on AdaBoost and decision tree
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the parameters of fuzzy track association algorithm are subjective and numerous, and the robustness of the algorithm is poor when the sensor measurement is lost and the target maneuvers, an improved track association algorithm based on AdaBoost and decision tree is proposed. The algorithm transforms the track association problem into a binary classification problem. Firstly, based on the measurement of the dispersion between local tracks, the association factor set of the local tracks of two sensors is transformed into a data set which is easy to classify. Then, the AdaBoost and decision tree algorithm are used to train a strong classifier using the historical track association information. Finally, the strong classifier is used to classify the new local track information of multi-sensor, then the local track association results are obtained. Simulation results show that the algorithm can deal with the track association problem of multi-target maneuvering cross motion when the measurement is lost, and the track association accuracy is higher than the existing fuzzy track association algorithm.

articleTitle: Analysis of jamming positioning technology in satellite communication
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: With the rapid development of the communications satellite, the problem of communication interference becomes more and more obvious. Once the interference appears, it needs to be solved quickly to ensure the smooth development of the communication service. According to the coverage characteristics of multi-track, multi-band, area beam and point beam of the communications satellite, the jamming positioning technology under different jamming scenarios is analyzed, and the optimal jamming positioning implementation method is studied, laying the Technical Foundation for the later period system construction application.

articleTitle: Human protein subcellular localization prediction based on error correcting output coding strategy while combining immunohistochemistry image and amino acid sequence
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Human protein subcellular localization prediction is essential for understanding function of proteins. Only when the proteins arrive at the right place at the right time can they perform their functions. In the past decades, various methods based on machine learning have been proposed to predict the subcellular localization of proteins. However, a common drawback is that most of these methods only focus on single signal of proteins, such as amino acid sequences or protein images. In this paper, a novel prediction model based on error correcting output coding (ECOC) strategy was proposed, which named ECOC-locator. It has two advantages, one is that ECOC-locator takes full advantage of amino acid sequence information, for example, rich context information of amino acid sequences, and takes interpretability of protein images into account. The other is that ECOC-locator balances the class contributions of the two signals to the prediction model by employing ECOC. The ensemble classifier integrated 8 classifiers, five of which were trained by immunohistochemistry (IHC) images and the rest trained by amino acid sequence data. The experimental results show that the accuracy of ECOC-locator can reach 40.34%, which fully demonstrates the effectiveness.

articleTitle: An efficient method for cross-subject EEG-based mental fatigue recognition
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Mental fatigue has an unignorable impact on people's daily life and work. Mental fatigue recognition methods based on EEG are commonly thought as objective standard. However, the procedure of initiating fatigue needs a long time and EEG signals vary greatly, so mental fatigue recognition based on EEG is challenging when subject-specific data are limited and imbalanced. In this paper, we explored the performance of cross-subject fatigue recognition on a general multitask learning framework with two data sampling methods for imbalanced classification. One was to synthesize some minority samples (MTLSMS) until the two classes were balanced and another was to under-sample the majority samples (MTLUMS). EEG data of 11 subjects from a public EEG fatigue dataset were selected to validate our fatigue recognition methods. The MTLSMS method improved the cross-subject mental fatigue recognition accuracies to 81.07%, and much better than other transfer learning domain adaptation methods Transfer Component Analysis (TCA) and Maximum Independence Domain Adaptation (MIDA). The experiment results showed that the MTLSMS method can effectively recognize the cross-subject mental fatigue.

articleTitle: An indoor positioning system using Channel State Information based on TrAdaBoost Tranfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: With the rapidly growing demand for Location-Based Services in indoor environments, fingerprint-based indoor positioning has caused great interest due to its high positioning accuracy and low equipment cost. However, the standard signal radio map cannot provide consistent high positioning accuracy under environmental changes and new scenarios. To address this problem, we present a novel indoor positioning Transfer Learning(TL) system based on improved TrAdaBoost. We perform phase correction on the raw CSI phase, then use One-vs-Rest algorithm and One-Hot coding, which can realize the multi-classification ability of the TrAdaBoost algorithm. Meanwhile, we use a correction factor to slow down the weight of the source domain and make the fingerprint of the source domain better transfer to the target domain by the TrAdaBoost in order to form a new fingerprint database. Experimental results show that the positioning accuracy can be improved by 35% in dynamic environment conditions. The proposed method can improve the positioning accuracy by an average of 30% in new scenes and the Site Survey Overhead(SSO) is reduced by 40%. Experiments show that our proposed method has robustness in time and space, and has lower SSO under the same positioning accuracy.

articleTitle: Application Research of Spectrum Sensing and Spectrum Allocation in Cognitive Satellite Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Due to the increasing demand for broadcasting, multimedia and interactive services, more and more communication devices are connected to satellite communication systems, satellite communication systems are facing the contradiction between the exhaustion of spectrum resources and the low utilization rate of spectrum. Applying cognitive radio technology to satellite communication systems can effectively improve the utilization of spectrum resources. In order to better study cognitive satellite communication, this article briefly introduces the basic principles of cognitive radio and describes the application scenarios of cognitive satellite communication. Through comparison and analysis, the research status, advantages and disadvantages of spectrum sensing and spectrum allocation algorithms in cognitive satellite network application scenarios are summarized, and the next research direction of cognitive satellite communication network is prospected, which lays the foundation for future research.

articleTitle: Research on the Subsynchronous Oscillation Characteristics of Different Wind Farms Connected to the Grid via VSC-HVDC
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: With the rapid expansion of wind power construction projects, HVDC transmission technology will become one of the effective methods for large-scale long-distance offshore wind power transmission. There is no clear conclusion about the differences and commonalities of the subsynchronous oscillation phenomenon caused by the VSC-HVDC grid connection of different wind farm types. Therefore, based on the eigenvalue analysis method, this paper establishes the state space model of two different types of wind turbines directly entering the system through flexibility. On this basis, the mechanism is analyzed, and the influence of system parameters on the system sub-/super-synchronous oscillation is explored by changing the system structure parameters and controller parameters such as wind turbine grid-connected capacity, receiving end short-circuit ratio, and transmission line distance. Further, through the comparative analysis, the differences and similarities are concluded. The time domain simulation on PSCAD / EMTDC platform verifies the correctness of the system.

articleTitle: Parallel particle swarm optimization algorithm based on spatial equal-scale segmentation and hybrid strategy
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: According to the characteristics of classical PSO algorithm(s), this paper uses the spatial equal-scale segmentation method (PESS) to effectively reduce the data dimension because of the low efficiency of PSO algorithm caused by big data and large population size. Diversity selection and global optimization, according to the law of evolution selection, the local optimization is focused on the two extremes of minimum value and maximal value, thus reducing the number of calculations of the fitness function of the algorithm. On this basis, we introduce a time-hop and elite Gaussian mixture strategy that can overcome the particle plunging into local optimum, while improving the efficiency of the algorithm, the generalization ability of the algorithm is taken into account. In order to prove the performance of FSPSO, we chose PSO and the self-organizing migration algorithm (SOMA) evolved from PSO that were tested in 30, 60 and 100 comparison tests on 5 different test function set with different degrees of complexity. The experimental results show that we proposed FSPSO algorithm has good effectiveness, robustness, complexity and universality in solving global optimization problems.

articleTitle: CSF: convolution sequential fusion model for session recommender system
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Capturing users’ specific preferences is a fundamental problem in a large-scale recommender system. Currently, Sequence-based session recommendation has become a hot research direction in the industry. However, the current approach is somewhat inadequate in capturing user’s long-term preferences. We propose a session model based on convolution sequential fusion (CSF) to capture users' specific preferences by fusing users' long-term behaviors and short-term sessions. Compared with existing sequential recommendations, we address two inherent weaknesses of session recommendations: 1) The interaction of long-term interest features is not sufficiently extracted. 2) The combination of long-term interest and short-term interest is too simplistic. The long-term interests of users are varied and complex. simultaneously, users' long-term interests are closely related to their short-term interests, so they should be better integrated. We propose to encode the behavior sequence with two corresponding components: the convolutional network for interactive extraction of users' long-term interests and the long-short term gated fusion module for better combination of long-short preferences Our entire model has been test on multiple real-world data sets, and the results demonstrate that our model is more effective than other recent models on multiple evaluation benchmarks.

articleTitle: Research on Steganalysis of Digital Image Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Steganography is a technique and science of information hiding. Corresponding to the development of image steganography, steganalysis has made substantial progress. In recent years, deep learning is widely used in the fields of computer vision and natural language processing. With people's in-depth understanding of deep learning, convolutional neural network technology has been introduced into the field of steganography and steganalysis, and has made a series of breakthroughs and development in methods and performance. Under this background, this paper summarizes and discusses the main methods and the most representative work of how to apply convolutional neural network model of deep learning to steganalysis of digital images. Finally, it discusses the problems and future development of steganalysis and steganalysis of digital image based on deep learning.

articleTitle: Transient Voltage Stability Margin Prediction Method Based on LightGBM
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Traditional time-domain simulation method has long calculation time on transient voltage stability margin prediction problem, the direct method is difficult to adapt to the complex power grid model, and the deep neural network method requires a large data set. In this paper, we propose the method based on LightGBM, which has the advantages of appropriate model complexity and less training time demand. Based on a regional subsystem of Guangxi Power Grid with more electrolytic aluminum load, and a power system transient voltage stability margin prediction model based on LightGBM is constructed. To solve the long tail distribution learning problem, target clipping and log transformation techniques are proposed to enhance the model. The effectiveness of them is verified by experiment results. And we propose a new metric, partial RMSE, to evaluate the performance of the model fitting the instability data. The experiment results also show that it has achieved better performance and training time than other machine learning models.

articleTitle: Learning to Slim Deep Networks with Bandit Channel Pruning
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Recent years, deep neural network has achieved great success in machine vision, natural language processing, and reinforcement learning. While deploying these models on embedded devices and large clusters faces challenge in high energy consumption and low efficiency. In this paper, we propose an effective approach named Bandit Channel Pruning (BCP) to accelerate neural network by channel-level pruning.Inspired by autoML, we use Multi-Armed Bandit (MAB) method to explore and exploit the impact of each channel on model performance. Specifically, we use the loss value of model’s output as penalty term to find the set of redundant channels. In addition, we prove that the change of this loss value can be used as criterion of channel redundant. We analyze the complexity of BCP and give the upper bound of search times.Our approach is validated with several deep neural networks, including VGGNet, ResNet56, ResNet110, on different image classification datasets. Extensive experiments on these models and datasets demonstrate the performance of this method is better than state-of-the-art channel pruning methods.

articleTitle: Image super-resolution method based on generative adversarial network
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Although deep convolutional neural networks have made breakthroughs in the accuracy and speed of single-image super-resolution, there are still many unsolved problems: firstly, How to refine the texture problem when performing super-resolution processing at a larger magnification ratio. Secondly, the existing convolutional neural network image super-resolution algorithms are prone to overfitting and insufficient convergence of the loss function. Aiming at two problems, an image super-resolution method based on generative adversarial network is proposed. The feature map is spatially transformed on the network to solve the problem of refined texture, combined with CycleGAN and SRGAN, the network structure is improved and the loss function is optimized, and the SRCICGAN algorithm is proposed to restore the four times down-sampled image to solve the loss function problem. The experiment is compared with the latest six methods on three data sets. The PSNR and SSIM indicators are 1.92% and 5.49% higher in the Flickr2K data set, respectively, and better visual effects can be obtained in terms of detailed texture.

articleTitle: Enhancing the Anti-Cryptanalysis Ability and Avalanche Effect with Zeckendorf Representation via FPGA Implementation
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Recently, many investigations have been conducted on the security of well-established protocols and standards, and it turns out that classical cryptography has seen some plight stemming from statistical cryptanalysis, inadequate avalanche effect, and so forth. To address the aforementioned problems, we resort to Zeckendorf representation whose non-uniqueness feature suggests a novel paradigm for anti-cryptanalysis and avalanche effect enhancement. Specifically, it renders the ciphertext exlusive if we write the plaintext as Zeckendorf representation before encrypting (we call this an "obfuscation" operation). "Obfuscation" squeezes the chance of statistical cryptanalysts: it destroys the basis of frequency analysis by removing repeated segments in substitution ciphers, and disables differential cryptanalysis by running the attackers into difficulties finding the initial plaintext pairs of block ciphers. "Obfuscation" also slightly enhances the avalanche effect by magnifying the change in plaintext. Simulation results on FPGA platform had confirmed our analysis. This paper strives to add a small stone to the wall of security of existing ciphers.

articleTitle: A Cross Iterative Algorithm for Mining Communities in Bipartite Network
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Nowadays, it is of great significance to analyze the community structure for analyzing bipartite networks. Through the unremitting efforts of people, now many different community mining methods have arisen. But most of the methods need to ensure the number of the communities before mining, and relationship between the final community is one to one. This paper presents a cross iterative algorithm for mining communities in bipartite network. The first step is to determine the core of the community by looking complete sub-graph of the bipartite graph, after determining the core, alternately iterated the algorithm according to the core until the results is convergence. The last cores after the iteration are the communities of the bipartite network. Experimental results show that the algorithm runs excellent in a bipartite graph, and can mine many to many communities with higher quality.

articleTitle: Weak Supervised Behavior Recognition Algorithm Based on Domain Knowledge Graph
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: The use of artificial intelligence technology for technical and tactical analysis has become an important means and method in karate competitions and training. The integration of artificial intelligence technology and sports technical and tactical analysis is an important way to innovate and improve the technical and tactical level. In this paper, a knowledge graph in the karate domain is designed. In order to effectively use the domain knowledge graph, a new two-flow graph convolutional network is adopted, which includes classifier branch and attribute feature branch. The attribute feature branch maps the attribute embedding and score of each video instance to an attribute feature space. The semantic word embedding vectors of all concepts are used as the input of the classifier branch, and finally a classifier for behavior classification is generated. Finally, the generated classifier is evaluated according to the attribute characteristics of each video, and the whole network is optimized by the classification loss pair. In addition, the time information of the video is modeled by the attention mechanism. This technology effectively solves the problems of high labor cost, serious data loss, long delay, and low accuracy in traditional methods. The results show that the new model has a significant effect on improving the accuracy of behavior recognition, and it also lays a foundation for intelligent technical and tactical analysis. basis.

articleTitle: Predicting the Reconstituted Stem Moisture by Improved Decision Tree
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Moisture is an important control target in the tobacco industry. The moisture of reconstituted stems has an important influence on the sensory and process quality of cigarette. In the process of reconstituted stalks production, in order to ensure the moisture standard, the operators mainly rely on a large amount of experience for controlling, and different operators have different deviation in real-time adjustment under disparate formula. Meanwhile, due to the low level of the automation technology and the slow respond of the cigarette machine, it is easy to cause large moisture fluctuations and directly lead to unqualified products. For the purpose of solving the problem, this paper proposes a moisture prediction model based on Apriori algorithm and decision tree. This model inputs historical data samples to achieve the moisture prediction of each important process section, especially the width of 0.11mm stem, the deviation of the moisture prediction is only 0.326 comparing to the standard. After test and verifying, this model can initially replace human labor and realize intelligent automatic control.

articleTitle: Data sharing and distribution security protection strategy for the electric power industry
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: With the increasingly prominent value of data, especially the rapid development of the digital economy under the new Internet business, the need for cross-field and cross-departmental data sharing has become very urgent, and security issues have become a key factor in promoting data sharing. Many countries, including the United States, the European Union, and China, have formulated laws and regulations on data security sharing to promote the legal use and security protection of data sharing. This article analyzes the characteristics of electric power data, summarizes the current situation of security management and control of data sharing and distribution in the electric power industry, and focuses on the security risks that exist in high-risk links such as power data opening, sharing, and circulation. On the basis of fully analyzing the security risks and problems of data sharing, a security protection strategy for data sharing in the electric power industry is proposed. This strategy uses the automatic identification method of data sensitive data to realize the automatic identification of sensitive data of power grid business and the security protection of data sharing and distribution.

articleTitle: Dimension reduction of dynamic functional connectivity network based on clustering for ASD diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Brain functional connectivity (FC) network has been widely used to identify the biomarkers of neuropsychiatric disorders, especially dynamic FC network (D-FCN) based on sliding window strategy that can describe the characteristics of FC over time. However, many existing D-FCNs have dimensional disasters in varying degrees, which not only increases the computation complexity, but also damages the generalization performance of the network model. In this work, we design a network reduction scheme based on clustering strategy by grouping all correlation time series (i.e., dynamic FC series) in D-FCN into different clusters, then calculating the mean dynamic FC series in each cluster to estimate the reduction network. Specifically, the whole RS-fMRI time series is divided into several overlapped sub-series segments by sliding window strategy, and construct a temporal low-order FC network (t-FCN) and a temporal high-order FC network (t-HFCN) for each sub-segment. The set of t-FCNs is a low-order dynamic network (Lo-D-FCN), while the set of t-HFCNs is a high-order dynamic network (Ho-D-FCN). And then we use the clustering algorithm to group the time series in the network into several clusters to find the internal similar patterns of the dynamic FC series in the same cluster, then calculating the mean dynamic FC series in each cluster and stacking them in parallel to estimate the reduction network. Finally, we used the mean values of all the elements in each mean dynamic FC series as a recognition feature, and input the feature vectors into SVM for classification. The reduction network greatly reduces the dimension of feature recognition and by fusing different types of reduction network classification results, the final classification result reached 83.7%.

articleTitle: Research on Scheduling Strategy of Electric Vehicle Fast Charging Station Combined with Photovoltaic Generation and Energy Storage
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: The random fluctuation of photovoltaic(PV) generation and the random charging load of electric vehicles(EVs) will have a great impact on the power grid. It is an effective scheme to equip the fast charging station with photovoltaic and Energy Storage System(ESS), which has the advantage of suppressing the fluctuation of the power grid and absorbing the renewable energy. To solve the problem of energy management in Fast Charging Stations(FCS), a power prediction model based on EV charging behavior and PV data is studied, and a multi-objective optimization mathematical model is established considering the economic benefit of charging stations and the smooth load fluctuation, a dynamic ESS charging and discharging power constraint strategy considering both charging load and real-time electricity price is proposed, which is solved by Multi-Objective Particle Swarm Optimization(MOPSO) algorithm with mutation links based on grid sorting. The simulation results show that compared with the conventional charging station scheme, the scheme can improve the economic performance, improve the use of new efficient energy, and effectively reduce the impact of the original charging load on the peak load of distribution network, to reduce grid fluctuations.

articleTitle: Distillation for text classification task based on BERT
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: In recent years, with the rapid development of the Internet and the surge in the number of web texts, the demand for text classification technology has become increasingly significant. However, there are also the following problems: 1. The maximum input length of the model is 512, and some information will be lost if the longer text is directly truncated; 2. The model is large and the reasoning time is long, which is not convenient for mobile terminal deployment requirements. Aiming at problem 1: Firstly, the text with a length of more than 512 is intercepted. Considering that the end of the text usually contains more emotional information, the intercepting strategy is 170th and 340th. At the same time, another kind of text feature surface of the model is selected: The mean and maximum values are calculated respectively along the dimension of sequence length, which are spliced into column vectors as the input features of the model. Aiming at problem 2, the knowledge distillation of the model for classification tasks is carried out to achieve the reduction parameters to improve the inference efficiency to facilitate the actual deployment and application. Three groups of control experiments show that the overall classification accuracy of the improved BERT model is 97%, and the overall performance is more balanced, and the overall performance is more robust, which is slightly better than the BERT text classification model. The effect of the distilled BERT model is only 1.5% lower than that of the BERT model, but the number of parameters of the model is 92.6% less than that of the original model, and the reasoning time is nearly 4 times faster than the original model, which also shows the effectiveness of improving input features and model compression.

articleTitle: Research and application of streaming Data transmission and processing architecture based on Pulsar
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: In order to solve the traditional message queue technology in the transmission of sensor data streams low transfer rate, high cost and lack of stream processing method, is proposed based on a stateless Pulsar message queue and the time sequence database IoTDB flow processing architecture, data transmission of hydrological data can provide efficient and reliable transmission, data preprocessing and early warning, provide the basis for subsequent data mining work. As a high performance message queue Kafka is often used in sensor data transmission scheme, Kafka is used to perform the same transmission task for comparative analysis. The experimental results show that Pulsar is able to perform the flow computation well, and has advantages in transmission speed and system resource utilization.

articleTitle: Research on Railway Rescue Scheme Matching Method Based on Confidence Mixed Similarity
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: In recent years, the railway emergency accompanied by the rapid development of China’s railway can not be ignored. The important enlightenment to us from the accident death toll and huge property loss is that we need to make a reasonable dispatch of rescue resources in time to provide decision support for the formulation of rescue plan. Case-Based Reasoning (CBR), is to select one or more most similar cases from the case base according to the current new events combined with certain calculation methods, and modify its solution according to the actual situation to get the solution of the new problem. Therefore, this paper proposes a confidence mixed similarity case matching method based on case-based reasoning system. First of all, the rough set theory is used to determine the weight of each attribute of the railway emergency. Secondly, the rescue cases of similar structures are obtained by using the calculation of structural similarity. Third, in order to better mine the similarity between the attributes of accident cases, the attributes are classified to calculate the attribute similarity. Fourth, the historical cases can be screened by combining structural similarity and attribute similarity. Finally, the decision tree gain algorithm is used to establish a decision tree to determine the confidence index of the rescue plan. At the end of this paper, we extract some cases from the case base and calculate the similarity and confidence between them and the target cases to obtain the rescue plan, which verifies that the results obtained by the analysis are logical and reliable.

articleTitle: Safety Testing of Neural Network for Image Classification
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Artificial intelligence is an important driving force for the development of unmanned autonomous system. With the development of unmanned autonomous system, its safety problems are gradually exposed. Image classification is an important embodiment of the perception ability of unmanned autonomous system. In this paper, neural network of image classification, its safety test is discussed and studied. Firstly, it defines and introduces the safety and its related attributes. Based on the relevant attributes of functional safety, the safety testing framework of neural network for image classification is established, hoping to be able to make a comprehensive analysis of the safety of neural network for image classification. Finally, a data augmentation algorithm based on threshold is proposed to effectively enhance the safety of neural network model for image classification.

articleTitle: Web-based Design and Development of Safety Inspection System for Imported Civil Nuclear Safety Equipment
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: This article clarifies the top-level design and basic ideas of the safety inspection informationization of imported civil nuclear safety equipment. This article analyzes the functional requirements, performance indicators, technical architecture and network structure of the imported nuclear safety equipment safety inspection management system. This article introduces the design plan and some implementation details of the development environment, development process, front-end and back-end modules and database. This system realizes the unified management of the application unit and the application of imported civil nuclear safety equipment. The system is put into use in management departments and units, which improves the efficiency of administrative approval and has better security.

articleTitle: Design of Terminal Comprehensive Detection Platform for Electric Energy Measuring Equipment
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: This paper aims to effectively detect and estimate the performance of various electric energy measuring equipments. We design a comprehensive detection platform for the electric energy measuring equipment which includes the terminal comprehensive detection platform, the reliability test apparatus, and the dielectric voltage-withstand test apparatus. By designing the systematic framework, communication signal attenuation control module and test station, data from different kinds of acquisition terminals can be collected by the proposed comprehensive detection platform. The electric energy measuring equipment can greatly save time and improve detection efficiency.

articleTitle: Stock Index Prediction Method based on ARIMA-ELM Combination Model
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Stock price prediction has always been a concern in the financial market. This paper combines two models, differential integrated moving average autoregressive model(ARIMA) and the extreme learning machine model(ELM), to predict the closing price of stock indexes. The closing price of the SSE 50 Index is selected as the experimental object, and it is divided into the 80% training set and 20% test set. Firstly, we use the training set data to construct the ARIMA model; then use the fitted values of the ARIMA model, the selected technical indicators, and the trading indicators as the input nodes of the ELM model, and set the number of hidden layer nodes of the different ELM models on the training set. After evaluating the performance of the combination model, the optimal number of hidden layer nodes is selected; finally, the test set data is used to predict the closing price of the index on the constructed combination model, and the effect of the model is evaluated. The simulation experiment results show that the combination model is better than the single ARIMA model or ELM model and has a better prediction effect.

articleTitle: Quantize YOLOv3-tiny For 5-bit Hardware
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: As deep neural networks have been performing better and better on various tasks, their number of parameters has been increasing, and the demand for computing power and storage has been increasing. In 2016, Joseph Redmon et al. proposed a one-stage target detection method: You Only Look Once [1], which has been widely used worldwide in the past 5 years. However, such a scale network is not possible to be directly applied on mobile devices nowadays [2]. In order to reduce the network model, reduce energy consumption and improve the computational speed, we consider both network pruning and weight quantization for five types of large target detection datasets, prune the YOLOv3-tiny network to 16 layers and quantize it to 5 bits and successfully run it on FPGA, and the mAP drops about 5%.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of surface exposure rapid prototyping
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: According to the deformation mechanism of parts in the process of UV curing rapid prototyping, the equivalent mechanical model of layer by layer accumulation was established, and the warpage of multi-layer plate parts was simulated by ABAQUS software. The simulation results are in good agreement with the experimental results, which shows that the simulation model can simulate the growth and deformation of the parts accurately. It can provide theoretical support and quantitative basis for improving the manufacturing scheme of parts, such as the selection of growth direction and the addition of support. It provides theoretical support and quantitative basis for improving the process and improving the precision of forming parts.

articleTitle: Analysis and application of mine water inrush warning and prevention technology based on machine learning
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: In the process of mine construction and production, mine water hazards often cause heavy casualties and property losses, and even environmental pollution problems that are difficult to recover. To prevent such accidents, various countries and mine enterprises have paid great attention to them and based on conventional prevention and control methods, they have continuously tried to introduce new technologies and new methods such as informatization and intelligence. This makes the hydrological data generated during mine mining explode, but these data have never been fully and effectively used. Therefore, how to use mine hydrological data to better serve the safety of mine water inrush has become an important breakthrough in mine water inrush prevention. A mine water inrush safety guarantee system based on machine learning is implemented to realize a mutually connected system closed-loop, timely warn mine water inrush accidents, and recommend targeted solutions. The technical support for multi-angle is comprehensively provided to systematically prevent and control mine water inrush accidents.

articleTitle: Fractal Dimension Calculation of Rumor Text Based on Pixel Coverage
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Internet rumors are confusing and destructive, and it is difficult to identify them from texts, this is why rumors are flying all over the place. The rapid identification of Internet rumors can effectively control their spread and achieve good public governance. Considering the similarity between multiple rumor texts, based on the fractal theory, a fractal dimension calculation method for Internet rumors covered by pixel points is constructed. The Internet rumor text is divided into keywords and non-keywords to form a binarization matrix, so as to build a two-dimensional image with the same resolution, in order to realize the rapid recognition of rumors. When using the Internet rumors title text as a sample for model verification, the box-counting dimension solved by different matrices constructed by a rumor is quite different because of the effect of the increased pixel points when the equal-length heading text generates different matrices, that is, the shape of the two-dimensional image has a great influence on the fractal dimension. Therefore, it is difficult to realize the recognition of Internet rumors using the box-counting dimension algorithm based on the pixel coverage method.

articleTitle: Spectral Analysis of Analytic Signal
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: In this article, we study the spectral distribution of a kind of special matrix which originates from the dictionary of Cauchy kernels. This research is a part of our reconstructions of analytic signals. The numerical advantage of this result for sparse reconstruction lies in the fact that the singular values decay fast since the largest eigenvalue takes a overwhelming portion of the trace. We also give two numerical illustration and Python codes for this estimation.

articleTitle: Improved design of crown springs of connectors based on the finite element method
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of the existing crown spring socket, such as easy wear and short service life caused by excessive insertion force, this paper proposes a parameterized simulation optimization method based on finite element. Firstly, the parametric modeling of the crown spring socket is carried out, the throat circle radius and groove width are selected as the parameters of the crown spring structure design, the maximum stress and insertion force of the crown spring socket are selected as the target parameters, and the multi-objective optimization analysis is carried out by using ANSYS Workbench software. The results show that the maximum stress of the optimized crown spring is less than the yield strength of the material, the insertion force is reduced by 52.63% on the premise of meeting the minimum separation force requirements, and the contact reliability of the crown spring socket is greatly improved.

articleTitle: FRSK visual odometey based on FREAK
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: For the needs of vision navigation and positioning of mobile robot, a new visual odometer design algorithm frsk (fast retina sieve keyframe) based on fast retina keypoint is proposed. For the problem of feature detection and matching, the sample of free algorithm is completed by imitating human visual system. The pattern is divided into four parts, the closer it is to the center point, the clearer it is. In order to reduce the error of pose estimation as much as possible, a new method of pose estimation is used to estimate the motion of the camera based on the 3D coordinates of the matched feature points. In order to make local map more accurate and reduce storage space, the new key frame screening and reducing key redundancy method is adopted in this paper. The matching pictures are divided into various regions. The key frames are determined according to the number of successful matching points and the ratio of successful matching areas. After a period of time, the key frames are further screened. According to the data set experiment, the new visual odometer proposed in this paper has improved the accuracy by 9.3% and the operating speed of 83ms.

articleTitle: Detection of characters ink dot defects on the surface of industrial products
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of long time-consuming and poor adaptive ability of the current character printing quality inspection system, a character quality detection system based on machine vision is proposed for the inkjet printing method. Prior knowledge is used to divide the entire character area into individual character areas. Then template matching is carried out for each single character area. The template matching result is further operated to find the inner area of the character.The inner area of the character refers to the area that should be printed by inkjet printing. The dot area detection method is used for the inner area of the character to detect whether there are missing ink dots or blurred ink dots, as well as inaccurate ink dots. The detection system has good performance under uneven illumination and machine jitter conditions in actual production line. The detection speed of a single character can reach within 15ms, and the detection speed of a single sample can reach within 300ms. After experimentation, the comprehensive detection success rate of the three defects is 86.68%, and the false detection rate reaches 0.71%.

articleTitle: Disruption and Fusion Learning for Fine-grained Image Recognition
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a novel "Disruption and Fusion Learning" (DFL) method to improve the accuracy of fine-grained image recognition and acquire "sharp eyes" by training the classification model. As the first step of our method, a shuffled image is acquired by controllable shuffling, that is, replacing the block matrix of the original image in a controllable range. This step destructs global structure information in the image but retain local details, forcing the model network to focus on the distinguishing local areas to get useful local feature information for recognition. At the same time, global feature information is extracted by the original image with the same structure network. Those two steam of feature later are computed by knowledge distillation part, which distills and concentrates the features both from the original image and the shuffled image to obtain effective features that help improve the recognition rate of the model. By conducting experiments on three widely used fine-grained image recognition datasets (CUB-200-2011, Stanford Cars, Stanford Dogs), our method achieves state-of-the-art performance.

articleTitle: DOA Estimation based on Cross-Spectrum through a Co-Prime Array
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: In digital sonar system, cross-spectral orientation method is closer for Cramer-Rao lower bound, which is more simple and widely used than other high resolution algorithms. This work introduces a cross-spectral orientation method based on coprime array. In order to show the advantage of the proposed algorithm, the performance is compared with that of the linear.

articleTitle: Power system distributed state estimation method based on transfer learning under sparse data
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: With the development of smart grids and the continuous penetration of new energy power generation, the scale of the power grid has increased, and the structure and operation methods have become increasingly complex. In order to more accurately grasp the operating status of the power grid, it is necessary to estimate the operating status of the power system. In recent years, with the development of artificial intelligence and data mining technology, neural networks have also been widely used in the field of state estimation. However, there are few researches on artificial intelligence algorithms in active distribution network state estimation, and the small amount of data in the bad data detection link that needs to be carried out before state estimation also limits the application of many artificial intelligence algorithms that require a large number of training samples. A small sample learning method applied to the detection of bad data for power system state estimation is proposed, which successfully solves the problem of the lack of available training data in building a neural network model for bad data detection, and solves the traditional method calculation speed brought by the massive increase of grid data. The problem of serious decline, and the accuracy of the traditional state estimation method is improved by more than 47%.

articleTitle: An Adaptive Scaling Cuckoo Search Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: The cuckoo search algorithm (CSA) is a natureinspired metaheuristic algorithm based on the parasitic behaviour of the cuckoo species, and it has received much attention for solving optimization problems. Nevertheless, the CSA still has some limitations when applied to optimization problems, such as easily falling into local optima and converging slowly. In this paper, we propose a modified local search method with an adaptive boundary scaling mechanism using a chaotic map, which calculates the search radius depending on the position of the current population. Thus, the search ability of the traditional CSA is improved for optimization purposes. To further verify the stability and effectiveness of the proposed adaptive boundary scaling algorithm (ACSA), we compare it with the traditional CSA and nonmodified chaos-embedded CSA (CCSA) on 25 test benchmark functions. The experimental and statistical test results show that the ACSA outperforms its competitors, which means that the proposed algorithm can perform better than these other approaches in terms of their search capabilities for optimization problems.

articleTitle: Variable DC-Bus Voltage Control for the Non-salient Pole PMSM applied to the Flywheel Energy Storage System
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: In this paper, a variable DC-bus voltage control is proposed for the flywheel energy storage system of non-salient pole PMSM (Permanent-Magnet Synchronous Machine). Compared with the MTPA (Maximum Torque per Ampere) control and the field weakening control, variable DC-bus voltage control is not easily disturbed by the parameters of the PMSM. The circuit consists of three-phase half-bridge circuit and half bridge circuit. The three-phase half-bridge circuit converts alternating current to direct current. The half bridge circuit depressurizes the bus voltage to the voltage required by the DC side. The variable DC-bus voltage control can be used alone in the speed-up process, and it can also be used together with the field weakening control. In this paper, the model predictive control is used, and the field weakening control is combined with the variable DC-bus voltage control. Finally, the effect of the variable DC-bus voltage control is verified by simulation results.

articleTitle: Design of Personal Emergency Refuge Equipment Based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: In recent years, every natural disaster has brought us serious damage, including floods, mudslides, earthquakes, so we need an equipment that can avoid danger on the spot. The emergency refuge equipment is an in-situ refuge equipment developed to meet the emergency needs of disasters. It has the functions of fire prevention, anti-theft, anti-vibration, explosion-proof, infringement and moisture prevention. When disasters come, many groups without professional training do not have the ability to escape, and intelligent emergency refuge equipment can provide them with temporary shelters, waiting for the rescue of professionals, and protect people's lives and property. This design is planned to take FPGA as the architecture and intelligent electronic system as the core. The hardware part is realized by taking the communication board, power control board, and interface board as the main structure, with additional structures such as sensor group and lithium battery management board. The software part is based on the Linux system, with the information processing and control module as the core, to realize the information reception of the data acquisition system and the information reception and feedback of the user's image operation interface and the MCU system. At the same time, in order to calm people's emotions when entering the emergency refuge equipment, the equipment also introduces an intelligent audio-visual system to support MP4 and MP3 format playback.

articleTitle: Visual Management system of Intelligent Factory tools based on Odoo
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: The management and visualization of intelligent factory tools play a key role in maximizing the efficiency of tool use and cost saving. Aiming at the problems of inefficient, error-prone and difficult operation of traditional factory tool management, this paper puts forward a tool management scheme with complete life cycle, state visualization and real-time dynamic management. Based on odoo open source framework, Echarts visualization components, OCR recognition algorithm and Postgresql database, an intelligent factory tool management system is developed. The system realizes the data management, inventory management and roller grinding management of workshop tools, and realizes the visual management of the whole process of tools from storage, grinding to scrapping. The dynamic management process is based on the local OCR identification algorithm, and mobile devices can be used to identify and manage the basic information of factory tools in the local area network.

articleTitle: Service Configuration Strategy of SIP Voice Gateway
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: SIP voice gateway, as the NGN network access layer device, its voice service configuration capability directly affects the business experience of end users. The traditional SIP voice service configuration is mainly controlled by the IMS core network device to turn on or off the service, or the IMS core network sends the service configuration notification to the SIP voice gateway and configures the service locally in the access gateway, which makes the voice service configuration strategy lack of convenience, flexibility and robustness, and the configuration process is time-consuming and inefficient. Taking the voice service configuration of SIP voice gateway as an example, this paper proposes to move the voice service configuration authority forward to the side of SIP voice gateway. Based on the half call model of access gateway, different pre configured number tables are loaded for matching to complete the voice service configuration to solve the above problems.

articleTitle: Dynamic modeling of a stick-slip driving smart surface platform
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: This paper is focused on the dynamic modeling of a stick-slip driving smart surface platform. A dynamic Simulink model based on Coulomb friction model and mass center shifting has been created and presented. Another dynamic simulation in ADAMS has also been presented for comparison. With the models, the influences of several control parameters to the output stroke of the smart surface platform have been studied. The simulation results are presented and discussed.

articleTitle: Improved model-based Rao test for adaptive range-spread target detection in complex Gaussian clutter
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: In this study, we mainly focus on the adaptive detection of range-spread targets in the context of compound Gaussian clutter, which is in possession of unknown covariance matrix. With the purpose to overcome the problem of performance degradation which is principally triggered by the limitation of training data number, the autoregressive process is applied to model the speckle component. Firstly, the form of Rao test is derived under the assumption of known covariance matrix of the clutter, afterwards the covariance matrix is reconstructed by AR parameters resorting to matrix factorization. The newly derived detector is proved asymptotically constant false alarm rate in respect of the clutter covariance matrix, and the simulation results have demonstrated the effectiveness of the new detector.

articleTitle: Prediction of remaining mileage of hydrogen energy vehicles based on LSTM
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: The research and usage of hydrogen energy vehicles are of great significance in solving environmental pollution and energy shortage problems. Compared with traditional fuel vehicles, which can use the remaining fuel to predict the remaining mileage, while the remaining amount of hydrogen in the hydrogen storage vessel cannot be directly obtained in hydrogen energy vehicles, so cannot determine how long the remaining hydrogen energy can support the vehicles’ operation. This is the "mileage anxiety" that plagues hydrogen energy vehicle drivers. This paper proposed a remaining mileage prediction model based on the operating mode of the vehicles. The operating mode of the hydrogen energy vehicle is divided into four types. According to the current driving data of the vehicles, it is judged which operating mode the vehicles belongs to, combined with the history running data, use the LSTM algorithm to fit the hydrogen remaining mass curve in the hydrogen storage vessel, calculate the remaining driving time of the vehicles, and predict the remaining mileage.

articleTitle: Design of a small hilly orchard UAV detection system based on OpenMV
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Orchard planting plays an increasingly important role in agricultural development and farmers' income. However, in recent years, orchard fires often occur, causing serious losses to farmers, and years of hard work are in vain. Orchard safety detection is becoming more and more important, and the traditional orchard detection method requires a lot of manpower and material resources, which most farmers can not afford. At present, the smart agricultural equipment on the market has some disadvantages, such as the sensor volume is too large, the installation price is expensive. In view of the above situation, this paper designs a small UAV daily detection system suitable for hilly orchards based on OpenMV technology. The system is composed of software app and hardware. It has many advantages, such as multi-function, simple operation, low cost and wide users. Its functions include agricultural product dynamics, orchard plant diseases and insect pests control knowledge, text broadcast, farmers mutual aid forum, image transmission, environmental data detection, automatic marking of mountain fire and other abnormal situations, aiming at providing the most intimate service for the farmers.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Finishing and Detection Device for Knitting Needle
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: In view of the slow efficiency of manual inspection of knitting needles and the uneven detection consistency caused by human factors, and the increase in labor costs year by year, automation technology has become a trend to replace manual detection. Based on the modular idea, the research group designed a knitting needle knitting needle finishing and detection device, so as to realize the needle finishing, conveying, positioning, detection, and collection problems in the needle inspection process. The rationality of the structure is verified by analyzing the statics model of the linkage mechanism and using the Solidworks Simulation module to analyze the stability of the mechanical claw structure. The whole virtual assembly shows no interference, the linkage mechanism can realize the specified trajectory movement, and the mechanical claws of the key components meet the structural design requirements. The designed knitting needle finishing and detection device is stable and reasonable, and meets the design task and action requirements, and provides a feasible solution for the automatic detection of knitting needles.

articleTitle: A New Algorithm For Robot Path Planning Based On Automatic Shunting Of Ants And Particle Swarms
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: This paper proposes a new robot path planning algorithm which is a fusion algorithm of automatic shunt ant and particle swarm algorithm. In the first step, the robot motion space model is described by the grid method, in the second step, the global navigation path is planned by the automatic shunting ant algorithm, and the third step is the particle swarm algorithm for local search and tuning to obtain the best path. Experiments show that the algorithm is very effective.

articleTitle: Research and design of elderly health monitoring and anti-fall positioning alarm device based on STM32
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: With the economic development and the improvement of living standards, the aging problem has become more and more serious, and the health and safety of the elderly have also attracted much attention. In order to detect and rescue the elderly when they fall and monitor the vital signs of the elderly in real time, this paper designs an elderly health monitoring and fall prevention positioning alarm device.
