The device is based on STM32 single chip microcomputer system and adopts modular design. It is equipped with SIM800 C mobile communication module and GPS positioning module. When the old man falls unexpectedly and does not stand up in a certain period of time, the device automatically calls the bound guardian’s cell phone and sends SMS to display the location and state of the old man. Sensors such as body temperature, heart rate and step number are integrated to detect the health data of the elderly in real time, and alarm quickly when the data are abnormal. At the same time, cloud monitoring app is developed based on E4A platform to monitor the physical state of the elderly in real time. The experimental results show that the device can correctly identify most fall states, and the false alarm rate and missed alarm rate are low. It can effectively distinguish fall and daily life behavior. The test accuracy reaches 92 %, and has high stability and reliability.

articleTitle: Experimental and numerical simulation study on the lifting and diffusion of explosion cloud
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Lifting and diffusion of the explosion cloud is an essential process for evaluation of the so-called dirty bomb. In this work, we have performed an experimental work on the explosion cloud of 30kg TNT equivalent, and obtained the morphological characters during the lifting process of the explosion cloud. 3D numerical simulation is also implemented on the lifting and diffusion process of the explosion cloud, as well as the diffusion feature for the aerosol particles by using two-phase flow methodology on basis of the discrete model. The simulation results demonstrate that the variation law for height of the explosion cloud is in agreement the experimental data.

articleTitle: Asymmetric software architecture design of High performance control chip applied in industrial control field
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: For the scene of high real-time requirement in industrial field, the homogeneous multi-core asymmetric software system architecture is designed. This architecture meets the requirements of real-time and non real-time collaborative processing ability in application scenarios, and realizes multi-core remote management. In FPGA verification stage or production stage, porting remoteproc management structure in a typical operating system (Linux), at the same time, the bare metal software and RTOS porting openamp source project. We customized and developed a multi-core management framework, supporting remoteproc API. Based on the implemented SGI interrupt, rpmsg protocol is implemented with the help of hardware IPC mechanism and shared memory, and cross processor communication between Linux and bare metal software is realized through rpmsg protocol.

articleTitle: An Optimization Method of Aircraft Centroid Balance Fuel Supply Strategy Based on Sequential Quadratic Programming
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: The fuel tank of the aircraft plays a role in supplying fuel during missions. At the same time, the centroid of the aircraft can be adjusted through the fuel tank scheduling strategy, so that the aircraft can perform tasks at the ideal centroid to obtain better flight performance and Safety performance. This paper disassembles the aircraft centroid balance fuel supply strategy problem into multiple sub-problems, uses sequential quadratic programming, improved simulated annealing algorithm, etc. to solve each sub-problem step by step, and finally obtains a better overall solution.

articleTitle: Analysis of Off-State Leakage properties of High Electron Mobility Transistors based on AlGaN/GaN heterostructures
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: The off-state leakage (I<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">off</inf>) properties of the AlGaN/GaN high electron mobility field-effect transistors (HEMTs) was analyzed by fabricating metal-semiconductor (MES)-HEMTs and metal-insulator-semiconductor (MIS)-HEMTs. The experimental results show that off-state gate leakage (I<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">g-off</inf>) for MES-HEMTs is larger than the corresponding off-state drain leakage (I<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">d-off</inf>), which suggests that I<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">d-off</inf> is a branch of I<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">g-off</inf>. I<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">off</inf> by the ion implantation isolation is nearly an order of magnitude lower than that by the ICP-etching isolation, which suggests the side wall under the gate electrode caused by the etching isolation can increase the I<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">g-off</inf> and planar structure formed by ion implantation isolation can suppress gate leakage efficiently. A linear relationship of I<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">d-off</inf> and I<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">g-off</inf> for MES-HEMTs with the gate length implies that the gate area is proportional to the I<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">g-off</inf>. This indicates that the edge effect on the I<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">g-off</inf> can be negligible. At the same time, the estimated current with L<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">g</inf> of 0 μm is not zero, indicating the gate metal covered isolation region participates in conduction. MIS-HEMTs can suppress I<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">off</inf> significantly, indicating that the existence of the insulation layer can not only reduce the leakage current from effective gate electrode, but also suppress the leakage current from gate metal-covered isolation area.

articleTitle: Complex Product Displaced and Missing Assembly Detection Based on Vision and Process Template
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of displaced and missing assembly defects of complex products, a detection method based on vision and process template is proposed. In our approach, image acquisition is based on vision and the process template is established according to the judgment rules of displaced and missing assembly defects in the assembly process. For extracting the correct detection rules, a process template matching method is proposed. We designed an adaptive extraction algorithm for assembly elements based on a combination of multiple strategies and constraints. Furthermore, the defects of displaced and missing assembly is detected by analysis of the feature and position relationship of the extracted object. We verified the effectiveness of the proposed method in the detection of displaced and missing assembly experiments.

articleTitle: Submarine concealment condition evaluation based on the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: The concealment of submarine navigation is one of the important considerations to measure the safety of submarine navigation, especially over long distances, there are many key links and many factors to be considered, and many factors determine whether a submarine is safe or not. The safety of a submarine can be measured by the submarine's speed, dive depth, and distance from the enemy submarine. In this study, the evaluation of submarine concealment conditions is considered as a multi-objective decision problem, and a multi-level fuzzy integrated evaluation method is applied to study it. Combined with the engineering application background, the simulation experiment is established. The experimental results show that the multi-level fuzzy evaluation system combined with the simulated annealing algorithm is very effective.

articleTitle: Reliability assessment of power systems with wind farms considering correlations
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Wind power has the characteristics of randomness and intermittent, with the increasing unit capacity of wind turbines and wind farm scale, it is urgent to study the impact on generation and transmission system reliability. In addition, there are different degrees of correlation among regional multiple wind farms because of their geographic proximity. When it comes to research on the influence on the power system reliability, the analysis result will be larger error without considering the correlation, which is optimistic for reliability assessment. Therefore, it is meaningful to take the correlation into account in wind power system reliability assessment. In this paper, IEEE-RTS 79 generation and transmission reliability test system is adopted to verify the reliability assessment of power systems with wind farms considering correlations. The experimental results show that adding wind turbines in the original power system, system reliability has been greatly improved; and the system has higher reliability with given the considering the correlation between wind farms.

articleTitle: On-line Monitoring System for Spindle Faults on Automobile Reducer Test Device
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: As a key part of automobile, the automobile reducer must be subjected to a durability test on the test platform before it is put into use, which requires the test device to be highly reliable. In this paper, the spindle fault monitoring technology in durability test is studied by a data-driven method, and an on-line spindle fault monitoring system of rotating machinery based on virtual instrument is established. In this system, the vibration and rotational speed of spindle are taken as the monitoring signals, and the feature parameters which can reflect the operating state of spindle are extracted by using the signal processing technology which combines the time domain analysis, the frequency domain analysis and the wavelet packet analysis, to establish a spindle fault identification model based on fuzzy C-means clustering algorithm, which judges the spindle state by calculating the current fault feature parameters and the membership degree of the known state in the model; finally, a set of on-line monitoring and diagnosis system software for spindle faults on automobile reducer test device is designed with LabVIEW, which is based on virtual instrument technology, as the programming tool, and the theoretical verification and the example verification are carried out in the actual automobile reducer test. The research results show that the system can identify the spindle faults such as impact, friction, looseness and imbalance on line in real time, with the advantages of high speed, high efficiency and high accuracy (98% on average).

articleTitle: The Algorithm Design under Dead Time Limit in Multi-pixel Photon Counter
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Due to its advantages of high sensitivity and low power consumption, Single-photon Avalanche Diode (SPAD) plays an important role in visible light communication. The Multi-pixel Photon Counter (MPPC) based on an array of SPADs has a larger dynamic detection range and has reduced the effect of dead time. However, the existence of dead time leads to a nonlinear response relationship between the pulse of MPPC and the incident photon. In this paper, the maximum likelihood detection algorithm of MPPC under the dead time limit is derived and the corresponding bit error rate simulation diagram is given. Finally, the experiment verifies that the dead time effect makes the output pulse of MPPC not the standard Poisson distribution, while the maximum likelihood detection algorithm based on nonlinear response relation of MPPC synthesized the effect of dead time, which makes the bit error rate performance better.

articleTitle: Dynamic Behavior Modeling and Working Performance Analysis of Double Horsehead Pumping Unit
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Double horsehead pumping unit is widely used because of its good balance effect, low net torque peak and low energy consumption. Through the system dynamics modeling of the structure of the double horsehead pumping unit, this paper decomposes the suspended point load into rod and liquid column static load, inertial load, vibration load and friction load, etc. and performs programming calculations. Pumping speed of the stroke and the point of suspension velocity, acceleration, load and net torque gearbox impact were analyzed. The results show that the dynamic model of the double horsehead pumping unit in this paper has high calculation accuracy, which provides necessary theoretical support for the application of pumping unit well system dynamics engineering.

articleTitle: An acceleration method for pairwise constraints cross-entropy algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Cross-entropy Semi-supervised Clustering Based on Pairwise Constraints (CE-sSC) can make full use of pairwise constraints by introducing cross-entropy as the pairwise constraints measure, which significantly boost the performance of clustering. However, CE-sSC suffers from the problems of slow convergence and local optimum, which impacts the running velocity and the searching space. The swarm intelligence clustering algorithms represented by Particle Swarm Optimization K-means algorithm (PSOKmeans) addresses these problems by parallelly computing the particles during the iteration. But in the multi-mode problem, some particles might deteriorate during the iteration, which impact the performance of these particles and impacts the searching space of the whole swarm. Therefore, in order to solve the above issues, we propose an acceleration method for pairwise constraints cross-entropy algorithm (SSACE-sSC). The algorithm takes Salp Swarm Algorithm(SSA) and the CE-sSC into account, uses the characteristics of salp swarm to optimize the clustering solution. Further experiments conducted in UCI data show that the proposed clustering algorithm can derive a better performance and velocity.

articleTitle: Summary of Data Acquisition Technology in Complex Equipment Test
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Testing is an important link in the development of complex equipment. The data generated during the test is of great significance to the verification of complex equipment for its design and development of subsequent models. Based on the characteristics of complex equipment testing, the technology characteristics and basic principles of common testing data acquisition are summarized as follows: network bus monitoring and embedded testing technology, display terminal image capture technology, clock synchronization technology, historical data acquisition technology, etc., which provide reference for relevant technical personnel..

articleTitle: Application of multi-fault diagnosis based on discrete event system in industrial sensor network
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: This paper presents a method to improve the diagnosability of power network under multiple faults. In this paper, the steps of fault diagnosis are as follows: first, constructing finite automata model of the diagnostic system; then, a fault diagnoser model is established through coupling operation and trajectory reasoning mechanism; finally, the diagnosis results are obtained through this model. In this paper, the judgment basis of diagnosability is defined. Then, based on the existing diagnosis results, the information available can be increased by adding sensor devices, to achieve the purpose of diagnosability in the case of multiple faults of the system.

articleTitle: Study of Design Means to Prevent Errors Resulting from Flight Crew Operating Landing Gear System Controls
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Firstly, this paper describes the background and the purpose about study of design means to prevent errors resulting from flight crew operating the landing gear system controls including landing gear control lever, alternate extension switch, tiller, rudder pedal steering disconnection button, steering disarming switch for civil aircraft. Secondly, it lists the design criteria about preventing flight crew errors. Thirdly, it analyzes the effect of errors resulting from flight crew operating the landing gear system controls on aircraft and determines the applicable criteria. Thirdly, based on the criteria determined above, it proposes some design means to prevent errors resulting from flight crew operating the landing gear system controls. Lastly, it draws the conclusion that the design criteria, the analysis process and the proposed design means mentioned in this paper are expected to be used as a reference to design means to prevent errors resulting from flight crew operating the landing gear system controls and the cockpit controls of other aircraft systems for civil aircraft.

articleTitle: Multiple solutions for q-Kirchhoff elliptic equations
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: In this paper, we establish the existence and multiplicity of nontrivial solutions for the q-Kirchhoff type problems, f(x,u) does not satisfy Ambrosetti-Rabinowitz type growth conditions. By using Three Critical Point Linking Theorem, some new existence and multiplicity results of nontrivial solutions are obtained, which generalizes and improves the results in [7].

articleTitle: Grid Modeling and Performance Analysis of Distributed Power System Considering Wind Energy Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Due to the exhaustion of fossil fuel energy and the gradual improvement of people's awareness of environmental protection, the proportion of renewable energy sources (RES) to the power grid is increasing rapidly. Among them, wind and solar power generation are the most common, but these renewable energy power generation has great uncertainty. The traditional deterministic power flow analysis method cannot be directly applied to the grid with high penetration of renewable energy. To solve this problem, we use DIgSILENT PowerFactory software to build and simulate the grid model, and a stochastic optimal power flow (SOPF) study is further conducted to evaluate the impact of RES penetrations. Two case studies with different size of networks, i.e., the modified IEEE 24-bus test system and a larger modified IEEE 118-bus test system, are implemented. DIgSILENT programming language (DPL) is used to calculate the SOPF in different wind power scenarios. Grid performance is evaluated using different power system indices, such as the voltage deviation, power losses, power generation cost and carbon emissions. Finally, the impact of changing wind power plants position on the grid is investigated.

articleTitle: A credit loan optimization scheme based on big data analysis under COVID-19
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: The sudden COVID-19 has forced many small and micro enterprises to obtain credit loans from banks to survive. The existing credit loan strategy research projects do not consider these sudden factors. From the perspective of banks, this article thoroughly considered the impact of COVID-19, credit loan risks, expected returns and obtained a credit loan optimization plan based on big data analysis. First, a credit risk indicator system, a Logistic credit risk quantification model, and a multi-target loan strategy model are established. Then based on the COVID-19 incident, the epidemic shock factor and the epidemic recovery factor were defined, and the degree of impact of different industries and enterprises of various sizes in the epidemic was quantified. Combined with the idea of random attacks, the model was closer to reality. We performed optimization analysis on actual lending strategies under different scenarios, such as pessimistic and optimistic assumptions about the impact of the epidemic. In particular, the scheme is easy to expand, and its ideas can be adapted to the optimization and adjustment of credit strategies under other emergent factors.

articleTitle: Design of the Fire Evacuation Training System for Underground Buildings Based on VR
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: In order to improve the self-rescue awareness and self-evacuation ability of the trapped people in the burning underground building and reduce casualties, we use Unity3D to design an underground building fire evacuation training system based on virtual reality (VR), which includes four modules: pre-training module, fire scene perception module, evacuation self-rescue experience module, and post-training feedback module. Practices have shown that the system allows trainees to conduct simulated evacuation training in an environment with a good sense of interaction and strong sense of immersion, and have a good training effect.

articleTitle: An Improved K-means Clustering Algorithm Based on Beetle Antennae Search
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Clustering is a process of dividing the research objects into different classes and has become an important statistical analysis technique in data mining; K-means clustering algorithm is widely used because of its excellent speed and high efficiency. However, the traditional K-means algorithm always falls into the partial optimized problem due to the random selection of the initial clustering centers, which makes the accuracy of clustering affected. In response to the problem, this paper proposes an improved K-means algorithm based on beetle antennae search. The improved algorithm uses BAS to optimize the initial clustering centers so that the clustering results can be more accurate. The simulation results show that compared with the traditional K-means algorithm, the improved algorithm improves both in efficiency and accuracy. are already defined on the style sheet, as illustrated by the portions given in this document.

articleTitle: Some Improved Strategies of YOLOv3 Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: To enhance the representational ability of object detection network and make it learn features more comprehensively, thereby improving the accuracy of algorithm, some improved strategies are proposed. Based on widely used YOLOv3, the spatial pyramid pooling is embedded to strengthen the ability of feature extraction in the local area, and the integrated dilated convolution and dual attention are used to improve the quality of feature expression. Additionally, the regression loss is calculated by CIoU to improve the localization effect of bounding boxes. Experimental results on the MS COCO (test-dev 2017) dataset show that the mAP of improved model increases by 8.8%, while the detection speed of algorithm is maintained at the original level.

articleTitle: Research on Deadlock Detection Technology of Parallel Program Based on Run-LTS
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: In order to quickly realize the deadlock detection of parallel programs and accurately obtain the abnormal scene information, this paper combines the deadlock occurrence mechanism to propose a deadlock detection algorithm based on Run-LTS. The algorithm detects deadlock by calculating the waiting-loop between threads when they request shared resources. If the waiting-loop is closed, the deadlock would occur. Otherwise, the request is successful. The lock set in the program is instrumented with the algorithm as a template, and each variable in the lock set is detected by the algorithm at running. Experiments show that the algorithm can quickly detect anomalies and return irregular information when the program occurs a deadlock. In addition, using the algorithm as an instrumentation template has better portability and engineering practicality.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on the Influence of Investor Sentiment and Stock Price——Based on VAR Model
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Under the continuous development of behavioral finance, the research on stock market volatility has been carried out from multiple angles. Based on monthly data from January 2005 to December 2020, we analyzed the relationship between investor sentiment and stock prices by establishing a VAR model. The results indicate that changes in investor sentiment are mostly dependent on their own contributions, and it will fluctuate in the short term due to stock market fluctuations and changes in the consumer price index. As a preliminary result, we can combine text analysis, machine learning and other methods to conduct more in-depth research on stock prices and investor sentiment.

articleTitle: Design And Implementation Of Integrated Real-Time Monitoring And Task Evaluation System For Flight Test
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Efficient use of test data is the key to ensuring flight test safety and improving flight test efficiency. Aiming at the problems of low data utilization and inadequate business collaboration during the current process of flight test, this paper studies the digital task sheet technology, subsystem coordination mechanism and data evaluation based on test point identification. And an integrated real-time flight test monitoring and task evaluation system is designed, which realizes the effective connection and data sharing of mission design, monitoring, analysis and evaluation, and provides the guarantee for the safe and efficient development of flight test missions.

articleTitle: Design of an automated logistics system for the high-shelf filter rod warehouse of a cigarette factory
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Zhejiang China Tobacco Industry Co., Ltd. Ningbo Cigarette Factory "Twelfth Five-Year" relocation technology transformation project filter rod elevated warehouse automatic logistics system adopts the model of decentralized control, centralized management, and comprehensive monitoring, and adheres to the advanced nature, economy, reliability, and availability. After coming out of the forming machine, the trays are automatically stored in the filter rod elevated warehouse for solidification and storage for more than 4 hours, and automatically sent to the unloading and launching system. At the same time, it adopts many advanced technologies and equipment at home and abroad, and uses AutoMod12.3 logistics software produced by Autosimulations of the United States to conduct system simulation research, which is of great significance to the development of industry processes and the promotion of enterprise core competitiveness.

articleTitle: A New Segmentation Method For Carbon Black Dispersion Detection
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: In order to judge the performance of rubber, an optimal threshold segmentation method for carbon black dispersion detection was proposed based on image processing technology and feature extraction method. The grade of carbon black dispersion and physical properties of rubber were determined, and the operation function of GUI human-computer interface was realized. In this paper, an optimal threshold segmentation algorithm(Unimodal method) is proposed. Compared with the traditional threshold segmentation(Otsu algorithm, Kmeans algorithm, Kittler algorithm), the algorithm retains edge information better. Samples were collected by Alpha dispersion detector (10 dispersion levels, about 500 samples were collected for each level), The eigenvalues obtained by the above four threshold segmentation methods(Otsu, kmeans, Kittler, Unimodal) are trained by BP neural network, The accuracy of these four algorithms are 67.71%, 74.14%, 66.84% and 87.76%, respectively. Experimental results show that the single peak method has better segmentation effect.

articleTitle: Construction of Therapy-Disease Knowledge Graph (TDKG) Based on Entity Relationship Extraction
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: The knowledge graph of treatment-disease relationship can be a benefit not only to understand, inquire, and learn the relations between treatments and diseases from a macro level, but also to obtain the differences between treatments to the same disease through the comparison of different treatments; with the aid of commonalities of some treatments, a treatment to a disease that has not been discovered may be recognized; and with the aid of the commonalities of some diseases, a treatment to a disease that has not been discovered may be recognized too. At present, the therapy-disease knowledge graph has become the focus of medical informatics fields. International and domestic Internet giants have deployed some products in this area. The basic method of knowledge graph research is relation extraction in natural language processing. This paper uses semantic technology to discover several sentence patterns expressed in the therapy-disease sentence, and uses a method similar to BERT, that is, using the known part of the sentence to learn the unknown part of the sentence. An unsupervised learning algorithm is designed that extracts the relationship between therapies and diseases. By extracting the relationship between diseases and therapies entities from the abstracts of 300844 literature on diseases’ treatments, 203,238 entity relationships were identified, of which 180,675 entity relationships were valid. The results show that the sentence patterns expressing entity relationships in the literature on disease-treatment are relatively fixed. The entity relationship extraction is performed by dividing the sentence structure by subject, predicate and object. And the accuracy of extraction is 88.98%, and the recall rate is 60.05%.

articleTitle: Research on Lightning Overvoltage in Building Electrical Engineering
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: With the continuous development of the modern construction industry, electrical installation occupies an extremely important position in the construction process of modern construction projects, and has a great impact on the normal operation of the project itself. In actual construction, relevant units and personnel need to strengthen the attention and application of lightning protection and grounding technology to avoid the hazards of lightning disasters to the internal electrical equipment and personnel safety of the building, thereby promoting the progress and development of the building itself and the industry. In this regard, the article first explains the concept of building electrical lightning protection grounding technology and analyzes the significance of lightning protection grounding technology applied to building electrical installations and related measures. Finally, specific quality management countermeasures to ensure the operation normality and stability of modern building internal electrical engineering is proposed. The proposed method is to ensure the overall safety of the building, thereby promoting the healthy development of my country’s construction industry and society.

articleTitle: Improved Locality affine-invariant feature matching
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: It is a fundamental and important task in computer vision to find a reliable correspondence between two feature sets. However, due to the limitation of descriptors, the raw matches are often polluted by most outliers, and the matching results given by the algorithm may be cross-exchanged in the images with similar features. Based on the idea of local affine invariance, this paper divides the image into several local sub-feature sets, and the sub-feature sets often satisfy affine transformation. Then, the local barycentric coordinates of the seed points of the subset were checked to eliminate the mismatching of similar features. In order to prove the versatility of our strategy for dealing with image matching problems, we conducted extensive experiments on various actual image pairs, especially for images with similar features, we established an additional test set. The test results show that our method has similar performance on the common test set compared with other methods in terms of efficiency and effectiveness, and is more competitive in similar feature images.

articleTitle: An improved Byzantine consensus based multi-signature algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Traditional grid-centric data storage methods are vulnerable to network attacks or failures due to downtime, causing problems such as data loss or tampering. The security of data storage can be effectively improved by establishing an alliance chain. However, the existing consortium chain consensus algorithm has low scalability, and the consensus time will explode as the number of nodes increases. This paper proposes an improved consensus algorithm (MSBFT) based on multi-signature to address this problem, which spreads data by establishing a system communication tree, reducing communication and network transmission costs, and improving system scalability. By generating schnorr multi-signature as the shared signature of system nodes, the computational cost of verification between nodes is reduced. At the end of the article, simulations prove the superiority of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Image Feature Point Extraction and Matching Method Based on Mobile Augmented Reality
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: In the mobile augmented reality system, the extraction of image feature points, the calculation of descriptor and the matching of feature points are the foundation and key of 3D tracking registration technology. In order to meet the real - time and stability of the mobile augmented reality system, improve the robustness of the algorithm, and realize the accuracy of the virtual real fusion of the augmented reality system, the image feature point extraction and matching method based on the mobile augmented reality technology is studied. This paper proposes an improved image feature point extraction and matching algorithm. S-ORB (Scale ORB) algorithm is proposed. The image pyramid is constructed by three times Gaussian filtering and three times down sampling. Fast corner is used to extract image feature points. The feature points are located by interpolation and described by rotation related brief sub calculation. Whether the feature descriptors match or not is calculated by hamming distance. RANSAC algorithm is used to filter and extract image feature points The false matching points are eliminated and the feature points are extracted and matched based on mobile augmented reality. The experimental results show that the accuracy of the improved S-ORB algorithm in the process of image feature point extraction and matching is significantly higher than that of ORB algorithm and brisk algorithm, and it has faster calculation speed. It not only improves the accuracy of image matching. It has better robustness, and better meets the real-time requirements of mobile augmented reality system.

articleTitle: The Effect of Satellite Remote Sensing Monitoring Technology on Ecological Environment Restoration in the Midwestern Section of Qilian Mountains
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: The Qilian Mountain Ecological Zone has an important location and rich biodiversity. It is the source of the main water resources in Jiuquan City. In order to improve the disaster prevention and mitigation capabilities of Jiuquan City, improve the Qilian Mountains' ecological environmental protection capabilities, provide ecological meteorological disaster monitoring, forecasting, and early warning services, use regional weather station observation data and satellite remote sensing monitoring technology to integrate high spatial resolution image data and geographic. The information system is closely integrated, and extensive ecological monitoring has been carried out in the areas of snow cover, grassland vegetation, and reservoir capacity in the middle and western sections of the Qilian Mountains. It has also played a role in monitoring and evaluating artificial weather modification in Jiuquan City.The production of Jiuquan Eco-Meteorological Monitoring Bulletin application products through data analysis and evaluation provides a scientific basis for the ecological environmental protection and restoration of Qilian Mountains, further promotes and guarantees the rapid development of local economic and social science, and strengthens the construction and service of meteorological undertakings.

articleTitle: Fault Analysis of 10kV Dry-type Current Transformer
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Dry-type current transformer is widely used in substation, equipment safety directly affects the stable operation of power grid. This paper analyzes a burning accident of a 10kV dry-type current transformer, the fault diagnosis and analysis process are elaborated in detail. Through the test and disassembly inspection of the fault current transformer, the fault causes are analyzed in depth, and the preventive measures are proposed.

articleTitle: Preparation of Co<inf>3</inf>O<inf>4</inf> mesh membrane and its oil-water separation performance
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: In order to deal with oily wastewater better, a kind of hydrophilic and oil-free Co3O4 membrane was prepared by combustion and persulfate oxidation on the surface of stainless steel metal mesh membrane. The surface morphology and composition of the membrane were analyzed by SEM and XRD. The separation efficiency and separation flux of the membrane were studied by oil-water separation test. The SEM analysis shows that the surface of Co3O4 mesh was evenly distributed with micron scale structure, and the existence of Co3O4 was confirmed by XRD analysis. Finally, comparing the separation processes of the five oil-water mixtures, it was found that their separation efficiencies are all higher than 90%, and the highest separation flux was dichloromethane / water mixture, which reaches 47064 L•m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-2</sup>•H<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>.

articleTitle: An Improved U-Net Method with Deep Feature for Liver Segmentation in CT Images
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Surgery is the best treatment for liver canner, segmentation of livers is one of the most crucial steps in surgery. The segmentation task is often done manually, making it tedious, labor intensive, and subject to intra-/inter- operator variations. Automatic segmentation of livers remains intractable owing to their low tissue contrast with respect to the surrounding organs and their deformable shape in CT images. The paper proposes a new liver segmentation architecture named DU-Net, which is composed of cascade U-Net based on deep separable convolution and deconvolution. We make use of the Dice loss function for training. Finally, we evaluate the proposed DU-Net on liver segmentation task under the dataset provided by the public 3D-IRCADb (3D Image Reconstruction for Comparison of Algorithm Database).The experimental result demonstrates that the proposed network can outperform the U-Net, FCN and RV-FCN methods in term of the performance measures, such as Dice score, VOE, and RVD.

articleTitle: Research on the Influence Factors and Genre Development Trends of Music Based on PageRank and LSTM Model
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: With the development of the new era, music is also developing. When artists create new music, many factors affect them. How to quantify the impact factor and predict the development trend of different genres during the evolution of music is a significant research topic in the current society. Based on the relationship between influencers and followers in the influence_data dataset provided by Integrative Collective Music (ICM), this paper establishes a directed network graph structure to express music influence and uses the PageRank algorithm to dynamically solve the influence degree of influencers on followers to quantify. Impact factor development captures the parameters of "music influence" in this network. And according to the aggregated influence_data dataset, the LSTM (Long Short-term Memory) neural network is established to predict different music genres' development trend. The three types of MAE predicted (Pop/Rock, Country, Jazz), MSE and R2 are MAE (6.675) ,7.843,8.306),MSE(71.879,108.297,103.521),R2(0.762,0.659 ,0.676). The results show that the model can quantify the impact factor very well and achieve good results under these three evaluation indicators.

articleTitle: Prediction of Weibo Event Dissemination Attention Based on Markov Model
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: As one of the most representative social media platforms in China, Weibo has more than 500 million monthly active users. However, it is easy for events to be distorted in the process of spreading, resulting in adverse social influence, it is of great practical significance to grasp the development direction of social media events. Therefore, this paper effectively analyzes the heat of Weibo events based on real data sets, the predicted result is basically the same with the real result.

articleTitle: Zebra crossing segmentation based on dilated convolutions
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Zebra crossing segmentation is an important part of blind navigation. In this paper, We proposed a method based on Dilated Convolution Neural Network for accurate recognition of zebra crossing. The Dilated Convolution Neural Network is used to automatically identify all the regions that meet the characteristics of zebra crossing. After introducing residual network and Dilated Convolution, the detection effect of the model is greatly enhanced. The improved model improves the accuracy and reliability of zebra crossing recognition, and reduces the false detection rate. Through sample training and data testing, the results show that the Dilated Convolution Neural Network can recognize zebra crossing with an accuracy of 91.24%.

articleTitle: Location of Irregular Holes Based on Machine Vision
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: In the actual environment, the various deformations of the positioning holes of the mechanical parts and the different backgrounds will cause the circle to have irregular boundaries, which will cause the identification and positioning of the center of the circle to be inaccurate. Therefore, this paper proposes a centroid compensation algorithm based on the centroid of a circular hole. The algorithm first performs image preprocessing on the circular hole to enhance its contrast, and then performs binary and filtering processing to find its centroid. According to the binary image in the pixel The area occupied by the plane is used to identify, determine and compensate the center position of the circular hole. Experiments show that the algorithm can accurately locate the center of irregular holes with deformation, and has high accuracy and stability.

articleTitle: Design and Application of Integrated Marking System
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: The laser marking system was combined with MES system, the marking setting database was established by sorting out the product specifications, and the products of various specifications were quickly matched by calling the template, so as to realize the control automation of the product marking system and reduce the difficulty of processing non-standard products. Using image recognition technology, the marking area and the marking effect are digitized, the quality monitoring visual window is established, and the backup is stored in the MES system, so that the quality is controllable and can be checked in the later stage. The laser marking system introduced in this paper reduces manual intervention in production data to the greatest extent, improves the accuracy of information, sorts out various types and specifications of products, and sets up marking templates accordingly, which greatly improves the efficiency of cable network production. Finally, image recognition technology is applied to quality control to realize quality management and record, which provides reference for other production and processing system design.

articleTitle: Text information management of annual report and stock price crash risk : -- Based on Text Analysis Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: With the help of text analysis technology and data analysis technology, this paper takes the annual reports of China’s A-share non-financial listed firms from 2010 to 2018 as research samples to explore the relationship between text information management and stock price crash risk based on agency theory and information asymmetry theory. The results are as follows: The text information management of China’s A-share non-financial listed firms’ annual reports will increase the risk of stock price crash. Findings of this paper have important implications for the construction of the financial narrative disclosure system.

articleTitle: Image Quality Transfer with Auto-Encoding Applied to dMRI Super-Resolution
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: In recent years, diffusion-weighted magnetic resonance imaging (dMRI) has been widely applied in neurological examinations because it can reveal the microstructure of brains. The information extracted from dMRI are crucial for doctor in the diagnosis. However, the resolution of dMRI used in clinical practice usually cannot meet the need of diagnosis. Therefore, many technologies, such as machine learning are applied to improve the resolution of images. In this work, we studied the image super-resolution approach based on improved auto-encoder to reconstruct high-resolution images. Image quality transfer is regarded as the baseline, and high-frequency prior structural information are used as the features for training and evaluation of low and high-resolution samples. We compare our proposal with other competing algorithms on Human Connectome Project public data sets, and conduct subjective and objective evaluations. The results indicate that our proposed method outperforms the comparison algorithms.

articleTitle: An OSGI-MPH Algorithm for Solving Combinatorial Optimization Problem
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Travelling Salesman Problem(TSP) is a classical combinatorial optimization problem. There are numerous algorithms to solve it in the field, like Genetic Algorithm, Any Colony Algorithm, Simulated Annealing Algorithm. However, these algorithms usually have the weak global seach ability, premature converging capability, weak parallel ability and poor accuracy. Particularly, when facing large-scale combinatorial optimization problems, the algorithms above often require a great time cost. In this paper, we propose OSGI-MPH(Multi Parent Hybrid Algorithm based on Optimal Selection and Gene Insertion) by integrating a variety of heuristic seaerch algorithms and intelligent optimization algorithms. The algorithms and intelligent optimization algorithms. The algorithms has excellent global search ability and convergence ability. We test the performance of the algorithm in large-scale TSPLIB instances, and the results show that the algorithm has excellent performance compared with the traditional heuristic algorithm and intelligent optimization algorithm.

articleTitle: Analysis of Extreme Power Consumption of IGBT Based on Heat Balance
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: The maximum power consumption of the insulated gate bipolar transistor (IGBT) is an important part of the safe working area, which is related to the external heat dissipation device, internal thermal resistance and operating conditions. The maximum power consumption given in the device manual is an ideal value, which is difficult to reflect the actual operating conditions. If the design is improper, the IGBT thermal breakdown will fail. Based on the analysis of temperature characteristics of IGBT power consumption and steady-state thermal resistance of junction-shell, the thermal stability point, unstable point and critical point of junction temperature are obtained by thermal balance analysis of temperature curve of IGBT power consumption and temperature curve of junction-shell heat transfer power consumption, and then the limit power consumption of IGBT at critical point is obtained. The thermal failure mechanism of IGBT is analyzed for the positive feedback relationship between IGBT junction temperature and power consumption at unstable point, and finally experimental verification is carried out.

articleTitle: A fault diagnosis method for Marine shore power based on a phased analytical model
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: When the fault occurs when the port ship is connected to the land power grid, the fault elements can be found quickly and accurately. After in-depth analysis and comparison of the unique improved analytic model of fault diagnosis and the traditional analytic model of Marine shore power system, combining the advantages and disadvantages of the two models, a hierarchical analytic model of Marine shore power system is established. In the first stage, the influence of circuit breakers and other components on the objective function value is analyzed. On this basis, the fault measurement index of components is established from the two aspects of protection action correlation and circuit breaker action correlation, so as to realize the rapid screening of suspicious components. In the second stage, the fault hypothesis is introduced into the suspect elements, and the diagnostic objective function reflecting the action logic error and information communication error of the protection system is established. Finally, the improved particle swarm optimization algorithm is used to solve the mathematical model of fault diagnosis. Compared with the common genetic algorithm and particle swarm optimization algorithm, the improved particle swarm optimization algorithm is not easy to fall into the local optimal solution and the convergence speed is faster. The calculation results show the rapidity of the fault diagnosis model and the accuracy of the diagnosis results

articleTitle: Fractal Features of Rumor Spread
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: In this paper,the fractal characteristics of the rumor spreading are studied by the perspective of time series constructed with the influence of rumor spreading.The values of the Hurst exponent calculated through rescaled range analysis indicate that the time series of rumor spreading are fractal with long-range dependence and self-similarity.The visual method is used to convert the time series into a complex network. The scale-free and small-world nature of the network further verify that the time series of rumor spread has fractal characteristics. These conclusions will help scholars to study the spread of rumor from a new perspective and provide ideas for the governance of rumor.

articleTitle: Spatial Filtering Velocimetry Without Tracer Substance Using linear CCD
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Velocity is undoubtedly a fundamental parameter in daily life. Previous studies revealed that the optical velocimetry has the features of non-interfering, non-contact and high accuracy, which make this method welcomed. An optical spatial filtering velocimetry (SFV) will be introduced in this paper. It measures in-plane velocity by measuring signal frequency instead of getting the displacement per unit time. In order to set up an experimental device, we discussed this velocimetry theoretically and obtained the requirements for spatial filter (SF) such as the transmission function. Furthermore, an experiment which is based on taking a linear CCD as a combine of SF and photodetector (PD) is performed, and a lens is also needed for imaging. Analysis of the signal frequency shows that SFV is effective even without a tracer substance to gain the objective displacement, which promises SFV extensive applications. Another attraction of SFV is that a laser as light source is not necessary, which means a cheap broad-spectrum light source can meet the requirement. Thanks to advantages mentioned above, we applied this velocimetry to a specific industrial condition where a small object moves in a plane, and we tested this velocimetry when the velocity is 2.5m/s below and the error of maximum velocity is around 3%-7%.

articleTitle: Multi-scene automatic monitoring system based on edge cloud collaboration
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: In this paper, we propose an multi-scene automatic monitoring system based on edge cloud cooperation, which uses multiple high sampling-rate robotic total stations and reflectors to observe in multiple directions, and the data information is transmitted to the edge nodes in real time. The embedded gateway device is deployed at the edge of the network, which provides lightweight connection management through network connection, protocol conversion and other functions to realize the device connection to the cloud. Data is uploaded to the cloud through differential processing. The cloud provides cloud applications, cloud services and cloud storage, and analyzes, processes, stores and real-time monitoring and warning of the collected information. After actual testing, the system can achieve continuous, real-time and high-precision collection deformation data and early warning.

articleTitle: Eu-doped CsPbBr<inf>3</inf> perovskite nanocrystals
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: CsPbX<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> (X=Cl, Br, I) perovskite nanocrystals materials, as a new class of potential light-emitting application for displays, have demonstrated exceptional narrow line width ideal for achieving wide color gamut. Nevertheless, because it contains the heavy-metal lead, the prospect of their application is becoming less promising. In this work, we used the lanthanide element Eu to replace the toxic lead (Pb) through a modified hot-injection method. The concentration of Eu was up to 43%, while maintaining the perovskite nanocrystal structure undisrupted. Moreover, the high photoluminescence quantum yield of CsPbBr<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> was also maintained (90% of the undoped).

articleTitle: Infrared/visible image feature domain fusion algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Aiming at the community security and other fields which has strict requirements on the scale of infrared / visible image fusion calculation, this paper proposes an infrared / visible image feature domain fusion algorithm. The algorithm first uses the principal component analysis (PCA) model to transform the visible light image into the corresponding feature domain, and then projects the infrared light image onto the feature domain of the visible light image, and then performs segmented fusion of its principal components in the feature domain, and finally the fusion image is reconstructed. Experimental verification: when only 95% of the principal components are used for fusion, the performance of this algorithm in parameters such as STD and MI is better than some multi-scale transformation image fusion algorithms, and it is more excellent in the presentation of feature information.

articleTitle: Analysis of Induced Current on ITER PF Converter Bridge Bedframe
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: In order to analyze the induced current of component under the ITER PF converter bridge, the bedframe of PF converter bridge has been taken for an example to explain this process of calculation in this paper. Firstly, a numerical analysis method has been suggested to calculate this induced current based on the actually physical model. Then, the induced current and voltage has been achieved according to this method. Finally, the experiment results verify the validity of the proposed numerical analysis method.

articleTitle: A design scheme for 12-channel bonding based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: This article first introduces the research background and working principle of the TX phase alignment function of the Virtex-7 series FPGA. Then, according to the application requirements of the PCIe protocol, a design scheme for 12-channel bonding based on the GTH IP core is proposed. This solution solves the traditional High-speed serial transceivers only support up to eight channel bonding problems. The simulation results and board-level verification results of the solution show that the solution can stably achieve 12-channel bonding, and at the same time, the link bandwidth can be expanded to 1.5 times.

articleTitle: Design of Motion Control System of Handling Robot
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Handling robots are very important for improving productivity, reducing work intensity, improving the surrounding environment, and ensuring work safety. Based on the kinematics analysis of a two-degree-of-freedom manipulator based on a slider mechanism, this paper uses an open motion controller as a development platform to carry out hardware design and software development to realize the flexible control of the handling robot, with simple structure and real-time control, open structure, standard programming and rich man-machine interface, etc. which can be widely used in material destacking and palletizing handling.

articleTitle: Design of a vaccine storage and transportation system in remote areas based on Raspberry Pi
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Vaccination can not only effectively protect individuals from infectious diseases, but also effectively prevent the spread of infectious diseases. The storage and transportation of vaccines have very high requirements on the environment. Generally, except for some high temperature resistant vaccines, the ambient temperature should be tens of degrees below zero. However, in some remote areas, due to weak infrastructure, unstable power supply and poor storage and transportation conditions, the vaccination rate of children there is very low. This paper designs an intelligent vaccine storage and transportation system based on Raspberry Pi. The system has the functions of process monitoring, storage and transportation traceability, temperature control and vaccine transfer. It combines software and hardware, and is suitable for remote areas. It aims to provide "last mile" service for children who need vaccination in remote areas.

articleTitle: Design of mining substation and interface based on STM32
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: With the development of science and technology and the improvement of production automation, enterprises have more and more urgent demands for on-site information collection. Mine safety monitoring has always been an important link in the production of mining enterprises. This paper develops a wireless monitoring system based on STM32 for mine substation design, which is used to monitor coal mine safety related indicators. The substation design uses STM32 as the hardware platform, connects with the interface through CAN, and uses uC/OS-II real-time embedded operating system and uCGUI graphics library, which greatly improves the CPU utilization rate and enhances the friendliness of the human-computer interaction system.

articleTitle: Application Analysis of Agricultural Machinery Protocol ISO11783 in Seeding Monitoring System of Precision Seeder
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: In view of the problem that digital agriculture is not yet popular in our country, and many intelligent machines are less developed, at present many international agricultural machines follow ISO11783 standard, but our country is still in the research and development stage, a set of precision seeder monitoring system based on ISO11783 STANDARD has been designed. This paper analyzes ISO11783 protocol, makes ISO11783 protocol of agricultural machinery of sowing monitoring node, gives the explanation, completes the bench test in the laboratory, carries on the agricultural machinery sowing test, the test result is good.

articleTitle: A preconditioned accelerated matrix multi-splitting iteration method for linear complementarity problems of H-matrices
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: In this paper, a class of preconditioned accelerated matrix multi-splitting iteration methods for solving the large sparse linear complementarity problems associated with an Hmatrices are proposed. Moreover, we use the preconditioner P = I + S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">α</inf> to preprocess the original linear complementarity problem. Furthermore, a practical preconditioned matrix multi-splitting iterative method is presented. Finally, we prove the convergence of this new method.

articleTitle: Brief Analysis of Short-distance Wireless Communication Technology and Its Convergence Development
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: With the continuous innovation and upgrading of science and technology in China, people put forward higher demand for the application of wireless communication technology. Although the application of short-distance communication technology can provide convenience for people's life and work, it cannot meet people's increasing needs of convenience and high efficiency. In view of this situation, this paper starts with the analysis of the application status of short-range wireless communication technology, and on this basis summarizes the integration development trend of its related technologies, hoping to solve some problems.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Evaluation System of University Based On Knowledge Graph
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: At present, the existing university student evaluation system has some problems, which are that the evaluation method is solidified and single. Besides, the evaluation positioning is imprecise, partial and lacks intelligence. It is difficult to give students reasonable suggestions for their development and deficiencies. This paper proposes a method of university evaluation based on a knowledge graph and builds the prototype system. First, we should analyze the existing evaluation system. Then the intelligent evaluation method based on a knowledge graph is presented. This method makes full use of semantic representation and semantic reasoning ability of knowledge graph and obtains more accurate and broader information about students. This method makes the evaluation system more complete and accurate. Finally, the practical example shows that the method is effective and provides strong support for accurate evaluation in universities.

articleTitle: Experiment and Simulation of Metal Jet in Magnetic Pulse Welding of Al-Cu Sheet
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: In recent years, magnetic pulse welding (MPW) technology has shown broad application prospects because of its unique advantages in dissimilar metal welding. The metal jet can clean up the dirt and oxide layer on the surface of the workpiece and promote metallurgical bonding, which is the key step in the MPW process. To explore the formation mechanism and characteristics of the metal jet, an experiment platform and integrated observation system for MPW was established in this work to carry out welding experiments on Al and Cu sheets. The complete metal jet trajectory was captured, and a smoothed particle hydrodynamics (SPH) simulation model was established based on the calculation of collision speed and collision angle. The results show that when the discharge voltage is 15 kV, the collision speed is about 404 m/s and the collision angle is about 17º. The metal jet is generated at the angle between the Cu and Al sheets, forming the bright flash. And the intensity of the flash caused by the metal jet first increases and then decreases. The metal jet is composed of metal particles that fall off the surface of the sheet after the collision, with the characteristics of high temperature and high speed. This work can provide theoretical support for the in-depth study of the MPW mechanism and improvement of the welding effect.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Measurement Uncertainty of Non-contact 3D Measuring Machine
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: The GUM method was used to evaluate the measurement uncertainty of the non-contact 3D measuring machine with image recognition system, and various sources of the uncertainty components were analyzed, including the uncertainty components introduced by measurement standards, environmental factors and instrument measurement repeatability. Quantitative calculations are made for each component, the measurement uncertainty of each calibration point is obtained, and the results are verified. It provides a reference for the evaluation of the uncertainty of the instrument with an image recognition system, and also brings great help to the majority of surveyors to use this type of instrument.

articleTitle: Short-term load forecasting for power grids based on MEEMD and neural networks
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: According to the non-linearity and non-smoothness of power load series, a short-term load forecasting method for power grid based on MEEMD and BP neural network is proposed. The collected load data are first processed by EMD, EEMD, and MEEMD to obtain several IMFs and a <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup>trend term, respectively. Then the obtained components are reselected to construct a new signal and algorithmic correlation is introduced to evaluate the new signal. Four models are constructed with the help of BP neural network, which are EMD-BP model, EEMD-BP model, MEEMD-BP model and BP direct prediction model to predict the future load changes, and finally, simulation experiments are conducted on the load data of a region in Shaanxi Province. The simulation results show that the method can effectively improve the accuracy of load prediction.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of an Intelligent Management System for Consumables in Open Laboratory
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: A laboratory device storage management system was developed and designed for the problems of open laboratory equipment borrowing and returning processes. This system is composed of embedded system and web-based system, and the data transmission uses TCP protocol. For the borrowing and returning of instruments and equipment, the system has designed a finite state machine to enable the instrument to transfer equipment information between the storage cabinet and the borrower, which improves the working efficiency. The system adopts the method of automatically sending email prompts to remind the borrower to return the instruments and equipment in time, and additionally the Gantt chart information display in the web to intuitively view the current borrowing situation of the instrument equipment. The use of this system makes the process of borrowing and returning instruments and equipments more convenient, and responds to the current paperless, energy-saving and emission-reduction policies, and also reduces the chance of errors when instruments and equipment are borrowed. The promotion and use of the laboratory device storage management system will effectively solve the problem of "borrowing and returning of open laboratory instruments and equipment".

articleTitle: A gas meter reading system based on users' gas meter image
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Aiming at the difficulties of mechanical gas meter reading, this thesis proposes a gas meter reading scheme that based on image recognition technology. Taking advantage of the concentrated histogram of the color saturation of the counter of the gas meter, the position of the counter of the gas meter is searched in the image of the gas meter, and the digital characters are accurately segmented by the projection method. By using the gradient feature of logistics barcode, the position of logistics barcode can be located accurately, and the position of meter number can be obtained indirectly. Optical character recognition technology is used to recognize digital characters. In the experiment, the search of the counter and meter number in the image has high accuracy, and the search time meets the design requirements.

articleTitle: Omnidirectional movement tracking system combining depth information
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that the traditional mobile tracking robot is easy to lose and has poor flexibility when following the target, a target tracking scheme based on depth camera is studied, and an omnidirectional mobile tracking system combining depth information is designed. Aiming at the problem that the image tracking target is not easy to separate from the background, a KCF algorithm was proposed to extract HOG feature from the depth image representing the distance information, and the scale filter was added to realize the self-adaptation to the dynamic target scale. To solve the problem of poor maneuverability of the robot, a tracking platform that can move omnidirectionally is built by using McNum wheel. By modeling the platform chassis and calculating the target image offset to the motor, the robot can realize omnidirectionally moving tracking with zero turning radius. The experimental results show that the image tracking algorithm can track the position and scale of the target in real time on the embedded system, and the robot can automatically follow the target at the set distance.

articleTitle: Decision-making optimization method for submarine attack conditions
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: As a strategic weapon with strong attack and high concealment, submarine's optimal operational maneuver decision is very important. However, the attack condition model of submarine can not be expressed directly by mathematical formula. This paper presents a method based on fuzzy comprehensive evaluation and multi-objective optimization to obtain the optimal decision of submarine. Firstly, according to FCE, the fuzzy evaluation index system of submarine attack condition is established, and each influencing factor is given a reasonable weight. After the weight of target layer is calculated by membership function, the attack condition of submarine is scored. In addition, this paper also uses simulated annealing algorithm to get the optimal decision of submarine attack condition, so as to get the corresponding subsystem input instructions under the optimal decision. The final simulation results show that this method is an effective method to obtain the optimal decision of submarine attack condition.

articleTitle: Research on complex system fault prediction method for massive data
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Fault prediction is a challenging problem of complex system. Furthermore, fault prediction plays a critical role in aircraft engines and the performance of their control systems. Using the robustness analysis of parametric uncertain systems, an improved algorithm is proposed for massive data. The algorithm takes the parametric uncertainties into consideration which can distinguish an actual fault from the model uncertainties. Application to an aircraft engine clearly illustrates the improved performance of the proposed method, the results show that the proposed method helps the system accommodate parametric uncertainties in the model and reduce false alarms and missed detection.

articleTitle: Full Power Compensation Configuration for Weak Grid Voltage Sag Based on Flywheel Energy Storage
publicationTitle: 2021 4th International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Quick charging stations for electric vehicles with large capacity would lead to voltage fluctuation and sag in the grid. A grid-connected topology based on flywheel energy storage is proposed to suppress voltage sags. The converter model is analyzed and the charging and discharging strategy of the flywheel energy storage structure is studied. The system based on the flywheel energy storage can compensate the active and reactive power of the power network, so it is more conducive to the stability of the power network and voltage regulation. This paper analyzes the influence of active and reactive power on power grid voltage, and proposes the coordinated control of active and reactive power to compensate power grid voltage. Simulation results show that the proposed flywheel grid-connection control strategy can effectively suppress the grid voltage sag caused by the instantaneous access of large load, and can support the grid voltage for a long time.
